products.name: Mondo Grass
products.description: Ophiopogon japonicus forms tufts of slender, grass-like foliage that can spread rapidly once established. Around mid-summer this Japanese native will bloom white to pale lilac flowers, slowly followed by a small navy berries. This evergreen perennial is a popular border choice for dividing garden and pathways. It will also grow as a dense flat ground cover in areas of deep shade to semi-sun locations. Flourishing is soils that are sandy, loam as well as clay based. Ophiopogon japonicus will tolerate frost and wind. Water well until established and keep soil moist during dry weather. Use slow release fertilizer annually. If planting in containers, use a premium potting mix. Ophiopogon japonicus will grow to a height of 25 centimetres with a width of 50 centimetres.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Sublime  PBR
products.description: Acmena smithii Sublime is an evergreen Australian tree. It is a Lilly Pilly, so it provides the same uses, such as screening and hedging, if pruned into shape. This plant has vivid lime-green new growth that slowly darkens over time. In summer, Acmena smithii Sublime produces an abundance of fluffy white flowers that will further develop into edible deep mauve berries. This particular variety will tolerate a range of conditions, including cold temperatures and light frost, and is also strongly resistant to psyllids. Plant Acmena smithii Sublime in well-drained to heavy clay loam. Acmena smithii Sublime' requires little maintenance and is suited to areas across Australia. This plant can be trimmed as desired. Slow-release fertilizer can be used to encourage new growth. Acmena smithii Sublime will grow to a height of 5 meters and a width of 2-3 meters, or can be pruned to maintain height and shape.

products.name: Lavender Sensation Blue (PBR) Butterfly Lavender
products.description: Lavender Sensation Blue has a naturally rounded and bushy habit, producing masses of stunning purple flowers with lavender-blue 'wings' throughout autumn, winter and spring. It is an ideal garden shrub, hardy and easy to grow in a wide range of conditions. Lavender Sensation Blue is incredibly versatile and used in a variety of garden situations, some include mass plantings, as a hedge or border. Lavender Sensation Blue is an eye-catching specimen in cottage gardens, rockeries and patio containers. The flowers may be picked for fresh or dried floral work, perfumes and potpourri. Lavender Sensation Blue is a hardy waterwise, low maintenance specimen. Plant in an area of full sun with well drained soils. Keep soils adequately moist and trim lightly after flowering. Lavender Sensation Blue can grow to a height of 1 metre and a width of 50 centimetres. Note: Edible flowers or foliage should be picked fresh from an area that has not been exposed to any gardening chemicals and washed before consumption. Flowers are often intended only as a garnish, and should not be eaten in excess. If you are unsure whether a flower or foliage is edible, do not eat it; instead consult a Botanist or your health provider.

products.name: Lavandula The Prince (PBR) Lavender
products.description: A gorgeous, fragrant addition to any garden, the Lavandula The Prince has beautiful long lasting deep purple flowers completely covering its neat, compact silvery green foliage. Flowering occurs in spring with repeat flowering following the first flush. Flowering occurs in spring, with a repeat flowering following the first flush. This hardy versatile waterwise plant is suitable for both pots and mass planting. It enjoys full sun, is fast growing and will be dry tolerant once established., long-lastingfast-growing,dry-tolerant,

products.name: Lavandula Purple Reign (PBR)
products.description: Lavandula Purple Reign shows deep, rich purple wings, creating a luxurious feel to any outdoor area. Perfect for outdoor pots, rockeries, coastal gardens and garden beds. Lavandula Purple Reign flowers earlier than most Lavenders, flowers are also long lasting, peaking in early spring. The blooms begin close to the plant, creating a tight, compact mounding habit, foliage is also tidy, compact and grey/green in colour. Lavandula Purple Reign is a great, water wise shrub and drought tolerant once established. Grows best in a full sun position in well draining soil. Prune once a year in late Summer by cutting back two thirds to maintain best shape. Fertilize with slow release fertilizer in early spring/autumn. Lavandula Purple Reign will grow to 60cm in height and 60cm in width. Note: Edible flowers or foliage should be picked fresh from an area that has not been exposed to any gardening chemicals and washed before consumption. Flowers are often intended only as a garnish, and should not be eaten in excess. products.name: Lavender The Queen The Queen Lavender
products.description: Lavender The Queen is an exceptional showpiece to have in any garden. The superior volume of darkest-pink gigantic wings at the tips of the flower spikes is definitely a 'crowning' glory! The flower heads are two-toned, deep burgundy heads with lilac bracts, and will repeat flower after the initial spring flush. The masses of flowers are supported by the compact plant of nicely contrasting grey-green foliage. This beautiful Queen of Lavenders, when planted in stately pots in courtyards, as a border around raised beds or along driveways will add a real elegance to any home. Also great as mass plantings. Perfect for cottage gardens this sure-fire winner is both cold and heat hardy. Ideal in rockeries for that added long-lasting colour and a great addition in those sometimes difficult coastal areas. Removal of spent flowers will encourage further displays. Lavender The Queen will tolerate dry periods but appreciates a good soaking if those are extended periods. products.name: Pittosporum Gold Screenmaster (PBR)
products.description: Pittosporum Gold Screenmaster is a resilient and fast-growing shrub that is highly valued for its stunning golden-yellow foliage, making it an enticing choice for hedges and privacy screens. With its dense and compact growth habit, this shrub serves as an excellent barrier and adds a touch of elegance to outdoor spaces. The distinctive feature of Pittosporum Gold Screenmaster lies in its glossy, oval-shaped leaves, which maintain their vibrant golden-yellow hue throughout the year. The foliage is tightly arranged, creating a lush and captivating display that brings warmth and radiance to the surroundings. While the shrub may produce small dark-purple blooms in spring, its foliage is the main highlight. Pittosporum Gold Screenmaster thrives in areas with full sun or partial shade. It performs best in well-draining soil and can adapt well to different soil types such as sandy, loamy, or clay soils. Its glossy, oval leaves remain vibrant golden-yellow year-round.

products.name: Myoprum parvifolium purpurea
products.description:
Myoporum parvifolium 'Purpurea' is a groundcover which produces small white, 'Starry' flowers which almost entirely cover its fine, evergreen, purple-tinged foliage during summer. An evergreen matting ground cover ideal for rockeries, dry, sunny banks, and low-maintenance gardens. Small, white, 'starry' flowers are produced in summer, above attractive, purple-tinged foliage which deepens in colour during winter. Performs best when planted in full sun or semi-shade, thrives in well-drained soils and enjoys extra water over the hotter months of the year. Myoporum Parvifolium Purpurea can grow up to 40cm high and 150cm wide.

products.name: Illawarra Flame Tree
products.description: Brachychiton acerfolia ia a spectacular Australian native, deciduous tree that varies in size, depending on the environment. Bright green, shiny palmate shaped leaves are followed by vivid red bell-shaped campanulate flowers, after the foliage has shed during October - March. An attractive specimen tree that is a perfect feature for large gardens and parks, suitable for coastal conditions, tropical areas and cool climates. While it thrives in full sun, acerifolia is a diverse species, it is adaptable and will tolerate a range of positions, climates and soil types. The growth rate will be rapid when grown in tropical climates, where as a cool climate will produce a smaller, slow growing tree. For optimum results, keep the soil moist during the growing season and feed regularly using an organic fertiliser. Brachychiton acerifolia will grow to a height of 10-40m and a width of 10-15m.

products.name: Peruvian Lily
products.description: Albizia julibrissin rosea is a small soft foliaged deciduous tree with delicate pink fluffy flowers that stand above the large, soft fern leaves flowering throughout summer. Very quick growing. A great feature, shelter or screening tree. Plant in full sun or part shade in moist well drained soil, prefers a reasonably sheltered position, water through the summer period. Marginally frost hardy. Albizia julibrissin rosea will grow to a height of 8m and width of 6m.

products.name: Persian Silk tree
products.description: Albizia Julibrissin 'Lophantha', also known as the Persian Silk Tree or Mimosa Tree, adds allure and elegance to any garden or landscape. Its finely divided, fern-like leaves create an airy and lacy appearance, serving as a vibrant green backdrop. With a graceful and spreading growth habit, this deciduous tree can reach heights of up to 9 meters tall and spread 6 to 12 meters, showcasing its beautiful form. The umbrella-shaped canopy provides dappled shade, creating a tranquil atmosphere. 'Lophantha' Albizia blooms in clusters of fragrant pink and white fluffy flowers during the summer, attracting bees and bringing vibrancy to the surroundings. It thrives in a variety of soil types and performs well in both full sun and partial shade. With its low-maintenance nature and drought tolerance once established, this cultivar is ideal for water-wise gardens. Albizia 'Lophantha' is a captivating addition that enhances the visual appeal of any outdoor space, with its delicate foliage, stunning flowers, and graceful growth habit.

products.name: Agonis flexuosa Burgundy Burgundy Western Australian Weeping Peppermint
products.description: A Western Australian Native commonly known as the 'Burgundy' Weeping Peppermint. Often confused with Afterdark, this particular variety produces spectacularly lush foliage, with new growth shaded a deep burgundy and reflecting a crimson colour when the light shines through the foliage. As the leaves age they change to dark green leaving the colourful highlights at the tip of the plant. When crushed, the pendulous leaves produce a subtle aroma. During late spring it houses clusters of petite white flowers that peek through the dark foliage. Agonis flexuosa 'Burgundy' can be used for screening, as a feature tree. This plant will provide stunning contrast especially when positioned amongst plants with grey foliage. Being native, Agonis flexuosa 'Burgundy' is well suited to the ever changing Australian climate. This variety tolerates salt winds, and windy conditions. Plant Agonis flexuosa Burgundy in a sunny position with well drained soils. Agonis flexuosa 'Burgundy' is requires relatively low maintenance. Water well until established. This plant does benefit from regular pruning to maintain density. Agonis flexuosa Burgundy can grow to a height of 6 metres and a width of 4 metres.

products.name: Agonis flexuosa After Dark Willow Myrtle, Jervis Bay Afterdark
products.description: An Australian Native commonly known as 'Jervis Bay Afterdark' as it reflects the colours of the night. This particular variety produces spectacularly lush foliage, shaded a deep burgundy, changing with the season with flushes of bright claret and purple foliage deeping to dark burgundy in winter. During late spring it houses clusters of petite white flowers that peek through the dark foliage. Agonis flexuosa Afterdark can be used for screening or as a feature tree. This plant will provide stunning contrast especially when positioned amongst plants with grey foliage. Being native, Agonis flexuosa Afterdark is well suited to the ever changing Australian climate. This variety tolerates windy conditions. Plant Agonis flexuosa Aftedark in a sunny position with well drained soils. Sandy soils will need additonal compost to help hold moisture. Agonis flexuosa Afterdark requires relatively low maintenance. Water well until established. This plant does benefit from regular pruning to maintain density. Agonis flexuosa After Dark can grow to a height of 6 metres and a width of 3.5 metres.

products.name: Dietes grandiflora Fairy Iris / Wild Iris
products.description: Dietes grandiflora is a grass-like plant that grows in a tight clump of narrow, sword-like leaves. During spring and summer, this variety blooms white iris-like flowers, marked with mauve and orange. The flowers sit high and proud on the branched stems. This variety is often called the Fairy Iris due to the delicate white petals that resemble fairy wings. Dietes grandiflora is a versatile plant that can be used for borders, water gardens, mass plantings and is also well suited to patio pots and containers. Plant Dietes grandiflora in an area of full sun to part shade, with well drained soil that is rich in organic material. Once established, Dietes grandiflora is quite hardy. Dietes grandiflora is waterwise and low maintenance. Fertilise occasionally and water during dry spells. Do not remove flower stems as they continue to flower for several years. Dietes grandiflora can grow to a height and width of 1 metre.

products.name: Dietes bicolor Mini Ballerina Dwarf African Iris
products.description: Dietes bicolor mini balleriina is an attractive and very tough plant. Great in full sun and tolerates poor conditions. it is fast growing, and has clumping narrow, sword like foliage. Dietes bicolour Mini Ballerina is known for its pretty iris-like cream-yellow flowers with an orange/brown spot on each petal. They make a good landscape feature plant. Flowers cream-yellow and orange iris like flowers, foliage clumping, stiff, narrow strappy green leaves. Flowers spring thorugh to mid summer. Grows to height of 50cm.

products.name: Dwarf Mondo Grass
products.description: Ophiopogon japonicus nana is a low growing dwarf form of Mondo Grass. A clump forming evergreen with short and attractive dark green, strappy foliage. Growing to only 10cm tall, it is ideal for edging around pots, thin borders and in between pavers. Plant in a full sun to partly shaded position with moist well drained soil. Low maintenance once established but keep moist during dry weather. Apply a controlled release fertiliser annually to maintain healthy foliage. Clumps can be divided during spring.

products.name: Phormium Wings of Gold Variegated New Zealand Flax
products.description: A small growing flax with attractive leaves which are green in the middle and golden on the edges. A hardy perennial and clumping plant which is grown for its upright, arching leaves. Flowers are produced in summer and attract nectar feeding birds. Easy to grow plant for low maintenance gardens. Also ideal for coastal areas, containers, gardens, landscaping and mass planting, Can also plant around pools, ponds or rockeries. Plant in full sun.

products.name: Phormium Chief New Zealand Flax
products.description: Phormium Maori Chief has stunning red variegated foliage which adds a spectacular contrast to any garden. Along with it's long strappy leaves and flourishing foliage, Maori Chief is perfect for specimen or mass plantings and can also be grown in containers as a colourful feature for the garden. Prefers well drained soil in full sun to partly shaded positions

products.name: Phormium Bronze Warrior New Zealand Flax
products.description: Phormium Bronze Warrior is a clump forming flax with striking strappy leaves of deep purple tones. This hardy and colourful plant is grown for its consistent foliage colour and uniform growth. The flowers are produced in summer and attract nectar feeding birds. Use the dark foliage to add colour and contrast as an outstanding feature plant, border in both the garden or pots and containers. This species thrives best in a sunny to partly shaded position, with well drained soil. Phormium Bronze Warrior is hardy, tolerating most condition and soil types, and is relatively low maintenance once established. Apply mulch in spring to reduce weed growth and to keep the roots moist. Protect from moderate frosts. Ensure the crown of the plant is not planted below the soil level.

products.name: Phormium Bronze Baby Dwarf New Zealand Flax
products.description: Phormium Bronze Baby is a clump-forming dwarf plant that features upright, arching copper coloured foliage. In summer, flower spikes are produced which attract nectar feeding birds. As Bronze Baby is a dwarf form, it is perfect for those with small spaces in their gardens and is an outstanding feature plant, border in both the garden bed or pots and containers. This species thrives best in a sunny to partly shaded position, with well drained soil. Phormium Bronze Baby is hardy, tolerating most condition and soil types, and is relatively low maintenance once established. Apply mulch in spring to reduce weed growth and to keep the roots moist. Protect from moderate frosts. Ensure the crown of the plant is not planted below the soil level.

products.name: Phormium (PBR) Sweet Mist
products.description: Sweet Mist provides stunning colour contrast for the modern garden, with its exceptional bronze colour and is ultra-compact. Excellent choice for WA as it grows in full sun and shaded positions, tolerates heavy frost and moderately dry conditions. Needs adequate summer irrigation. Plant March to October. Use for for mass plantings, low borders, as fill in plant, in containers and patio pots. Plant in full sun or shaded positions. Tolerates frost and moderate dry conditions as well as a wide variety of soil types. Ensure crown or base is not below soil level.

products.name: Lomandra Little Pal
products.description: A low growing, clumping plant with grass-like foliage. small yellow, flower spikes are borne within the foliage. Perfect for creating borders, low informal hedges or as indivdual specimens in rockeries. also suitable for adding structure and foliage contrast in cottage gardens and perennial borders Prefers full sun, but tolerates part shade and a wide range of climatic conditions. Little Pal is a very hardy tufted plant that requires little maintenance. no pruning required. To maintain plant health and vigour fertilise annually with a native slow release fertiliser.

products.name: Lomandra (PBR) Tanika
products.description: A graceful fine leaf form of Lomandra longifolia from Ozbreed with deep green strappy foliage and attractive yellow flowers appearing in early spring. This Australian native plant has proven to be a tough survivor in many landscapes for the past ten years, including harsh roadside and medium strip environments to home gardens. Tanika is a low maintenance plant ideal for mass plantings and borders. This grass-like landscape plant tolerates full sun, moderate and full shade. Tanika only requires occasional watering in dry areas and times of drought and will tolerate most soil types but prefers to be well drained. Water regularly while establishing the plant. Water and fertiliser are rarely required after establishment as fertilizing will darken foliage. Trim to 15cm with sharp implement outside hot dry periods to generate new growth as required.

products.name: Lomandra longifolia
products.description: Lomandra longifolia is a native Australian grass it can grow in a range of sandy soils, in swamps and wet places on banks of creeks, rocky hillsides, cliffs and open forests. Lomandra longifolia is a perennial, rhizomatous herb with glossy green, shiny, firm, flat foliage. The leaf bases are broad with yellow, orange or brown margins and the tips of the leaves are toothed. They have clusters of white flowers above the foliage in late winter - early spring. Suited to landscapes, garden beds, verge plantings. Grows in full sun in most soils and can tolerate dry conditions.

products.name: Lomandra Little Con
products.description: An unusual and exceptionally small compact Lomandra producing small cream flowers amongst the foliage in spring. provides structure to the landscape when planted in borders, great for mass plantings and rockeries. It tolerates a wide range of soils and climatic conditions, suited to full sun and partly shaded postitions, requiring little or no maintenance. occasionally fertilise with slow release fertiliser to keep leaves a deep colour, exhibits drought tolerance.

products.name: Lomandra (PBR) Nyalla
products.description: This evergreen fine leaf form of Lomandra longifolia resembles a grass tree without the trunk. Its narrow, strappy leaves produce small striking yellow flowers from September to October which contrasts against its blue-toned foliage. Lomandra longifolia 'Nyalla' tolerates a wide range of soils and climates. This native is suited to full sun as well as shaded positions. The soil types Lomandra longifolia 'Nyalla' prefer tends to be sandy loam, clay loam and free draining light clay. Often seen in coastal landscapes, other uses for Lomandra longifolia 'Nyalla' also include mass planting in gardens, roadsides, and residential and commercial planting. The foliage is also popular in flower arrangements as foliage filler. Very little maintenance is required for Lomandra longifolia 'Nyalla'. Plant in a well mulched garden, fertilise with a slow release fertiliser early spring. Water well until established but avoid over watering in heavier soils

products.name: Autumn Blaze Maple
products.description: Acer Jeffersred is a great deciduous, statement tree, commonly known as the Autumn Blaze Maple. With an oval, to rounded form, the deeply lobed, rich green leaves change colour to bright red in late Autumn. Plant Acer Jeffersred in full sun for best results. Adapting to a wide range of soil types, including relatively moist/ wet areas, Acer Jeffersred is very popular for it's autumnal foliage and wide range of uses. Perfect for planting in parks, landscapes, medium-large gardens, street plantings or as a statement tree. Becoming mature within roughly 20 years, Acer Jeffersred will grow to a max height of 12m and width of 9m.

products.name: Canadian Maple
products.description: Acer Autumn Red, a truly beautiful Acer variety. Commonly known as the Canadian Maple and found in North America, Autumn Red is the perfect selection for a feature tree. An upright, deciduous tree that becomes more rounded as it grows, Acer Autumn Red is great for autumn colour in landscaping, street planting and large gardens. Acer Autumn Red's leaves stay green longer than other varieties, but it's seasonal display is worth the wait, turning bright orange to deep crimson in late autumn. Acer Autumn Red requires very little maintenance once established. Plant in full sun to part shade, water well in dry weather. Deep, regular watering is preferred, mulch well.

products.name: Callistemon Little John Bottlebrush
products.description: This Australian native produces stunning blue-green foliage with a slightly delicate, furry appearance. Throughout spring and autumn, Callistemon Little John forms masses of large bright red bottlebrush flowers. Callistemon Little John is a compact, dwarf species of Callistemon. This evergreen, bird attracting shrub will make an excellent addition to any garden or landscape. Suggested uses include screening, hedging, low maintenance and small native gardens. Callistemon Little John will thrive in a sunny position in well-drained soils. Callistemon are hardy, adaptable shrubs that will tolerate the poorest soils and withstand water-logging for extended periods. They are also strong against moderate coastal exposure and short periods of dryness. Callistemon Little John is waterwise and has a low water requirement once established. Prune after flowering to promote strong new growth. Callistemon Little John can grow to a height and width of 1 metre.

products.name: Crepe Myrtle Grande Red CM01’ PBR '
products.description:
Profuse, vibrant, bright red flowers and dark burgundy foliage
Ideal small tree size; can be pruned to a large shrub
Tested for drought, cold, and frost tolerance
Compact, red-flowered, drought-hardy tree for Australian gardens.
Grande Red™ Crepe Myrtle is an exceptional deciduous small tree that offers both beauty and resilience. Its vibrant red flowers and striking dark burgundy foliage make it a standout in any landscape.
This tree grows to approximately 4 metres in height but can be pruned shorter to serve as a large shrub, making it perfect for urban spaces.
Grande Red™ crepe myrtle is not only aesthetically pleasing but also tough, having been tested for drought and frost tolerance, ensuring it thrives in diverse climates across Australia.
This variety is known for retaining its leaves longer into the season, providing summer shade and winter sun as needed. Its improved natural resistance to powdery mildew even under wet conditions adds to its appeal, making it a reliable choice for any garden.
Size: Approximately 4000mm high; can be pruned to 2500 mm
Planting Density: Suitable for individual planting or as a dense hedge
Uses: Ideal for summer shade, winter sun, urban landscapes, street trees, specimen trees, and hedging.
Species: Lagerstroemia spp
Position: Thrives in full sun; drought and frost tolerant; suitable for Western Australia climate.
Care: Prune 300 mm yearly for density; water well for the first 13 weeks; use slow-release or manure-based fertiliser in early spring.
Flowers: Bright red flowers in summer and autumn, complemented by dark burgundy foliage.

products.name: Heuchera Black Taffeta
products.description: Heuchera Black Taffeta is a low growing small shrub with mounds of ruffled, shiny purple-black foliage that changes to purple-pink with the change of seasons. Deep pink flowers on short stems are produced from mid to late spring. Ideal as a feature, with great texture and form and is suitable for shaded borders, edges, mass plantings or as a specimen. Plant in full sun to partly shaded position in well drained, moist soil. For optimium growth, trim off tired and withered leaves during spring. Heat and humidity tolerant.

products.name: Hydrangea Magical Pearl
products.description: Hydrangea Magical Pearl is perfect for the classic designer garden or in your informal cottage garden. The rich green foliage contrasts beautifully with the pure white flowers which are long-lived and age to a chartreuse green and these can be dried and kept indefinitely. The flowering time of this top performing Hydrangea is Summer through to autumn and they are produced on old as well as new wood so pruning should be avoided unless necessary, although the fresh flowers can be picked at any time and this will make way for fresh new flower stems. If pruning IS required, do this in late summer. Hydrangea Magical Pearl prefers part-sun and afternoon shade. Plant in a well-draining soil using mulch through the summer months. Feeding in early spring with a controlled-release fertilizer will encourage vigorous healthy growth for the next flowering season.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Syzygium australae Pinnacle (PBR) Lilly Pilly
products.description: Commonly known as Lilly Pilly, Syzygium are one of the most popular Australian native plants. Lilly Pillies are evergreen rainforest plants with glossy, deep green leaves. Many varieties have flushes of colourful new growth, ranging from bright pinks, to red and browns. This particular variety is very narrow, tall and compact, producing glossy green leaves, with contrasting red-brown new growth. Pinnacle is ideal for hedging, screening and topiary and can be grown in containers. Plant in a warm area, protected from frost and well drained soil. Being native, this variety is well accustomed to Australia's diverse climate and soil conditions and once established will tolerate coastal and drought conditions. Water well until established and during extended hot periods. Prune to shape to encourage dense growth habit. Syzygium Pinnacle can grow to a height of 10m and a width of 1.5m.

products.name: Hydrangea Obsidian TM White Knight
products.description: The Obsidian White Knight is of interest even in winter. The unusual black stems are a nice contrast with other plants in the garden. In spring the amazing flower display commences a little later in the season with masses of the white mop top flower heads contrasting beautifully with the vibrant green foliage. White Knight is also an excellent cut flower and quite long-lived. Perfect for smaller gardens, patios and courtyards, as well as suitable for shady entertainment areas. The Obsidian collection is quite a vigorous grower and is frost hardy but can also withstand high temperatures. They are easy to grow and require minimal maintenance. Just a prune during winter and feed early spring or more often if grown in containers. Water regularly until established and it will then become quite dry-tolerant requiring occasional deep watering during hot dry periods.

products.name: Viburnum suspensum Sandankwa Viburnum
products.description: A hardy evergreen shrub Viburnum Suspensum has shiny green oval leathery leaves and clusters of fragrant white flowers during spring followed by decorative orange red berries. Viburnum Suspensum is an ornamental plant ideal for hedges, containers, borders or as a feature plant. This attractive shrub tolerates full sun and part shade, also rich well drained soil with regular water in the warmer months plus from regular pruning to shape. Viburnum Suspensum grows to a height of 3.5m and a spread of 3m wide

products.name: Peach Dwarf Valley Red Dwarf Peach
products.description: A compact growing Peach variety that produces medium to large deep pink to orange fruit with a sweet gold flesh, ideal for plucking and eating straight off the branch. The green foliage and the double pink blossoms provide a stunning all round tree. As it is a dwarf form, Valley Red is ideal for gardens with limited space, whilst still providing the added advantage of full sized fruit. This variety is also well suited to patio pots or containers, plant in a sunny position with well drained soils. For best results apply a complete fertiliser in winter and prune after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. Spraying to prevent peach leaf curl is recommended. Prunus persica Valley Red Dwarf can grow to a height of 2 metres and a width of 1 metre.

products.name: New Zealand Christmas Tree, Potutukawa
products.description: Metrosideros excelsa Vibrance is a hardy trunked shrub or small tree that forms glossy grey-green foliage. During summer, Metrosideros excelsa Vibrance blooms spectacular crimson pincushion flowers that are made up of fluffy stamens. Metrosideros excelsa Vibrance is ideal for hedging or screening as the foliage is incredibly dense. Metrosideros excelsa Vibrance will thrive in a sunny position with moist well drained soils. Once established this variety will tolerate coastal conditions. Metrosideros excelsa Vibrance is relatively low maintenance. Water well until established and throughout hot, drier periods. Prune as desired to encourage compact growth. Protect from frosts. Feed with a long term fertiliser in late winter after frosts have cleared. Metrosideros excelsa Vibrance can grow to a height of 6 metres and a width of 5 metres.

products.name: Lime  Tahitian Semi Dwarf Citrus
products.description:
The Semi Dwarf Tahitian Lime is a lovely and highly sought-after citrus fruit tree renowned for its juicy and fragrant limes. Its compact size makes it perfect for small gardens, patios, or container planting, catering to those with limited outdoor space. The medium-sized, tangy, and brilliant green-skinned fruit complements the glossy, dark green foliage beautifully, adding a pleasant touch to various culinary creations. The Semi Dwarf Tahitian Lime yields fruit all year round, providing a steady crop for your culinary adventures. To maintain its ideal growth and fruit production, this compact citrus tree requires regular watering and thrives in full sunlight and well-draining soil. Besides its delectable fruit, the Semi Dwarf Tahitian Lime adds an aesthetically pleasing presence to any outdoor space, delighting both gardeners and admirers alike.
Flowering SeasonAutumn / Spring / Summer / Winter

products.name: Indian Hawthorn
products.description: Originating in India and southern China, Rhaphiolepis indica Alba is an evergreen shrub, also known as 'Indian Hawthorn'. With dark green oblong shape foliage, and white star shaped fragrant flowers which bloom from spring to summer. An ideal screen, hedge or specimen plant, can also be grown in large pots and planters. Water well until established, and once established is quite drought tolerant. Rhaphiolepis indica alba prefers full sun and fertile, well drained slightly acidic soil. A reasonably low maintenance shrub, fertilise yearly, and prune after flowering to encourage new growth. Rhaphiolepis indica alba can grow to a height of up to 2.5 metres and a width of up to 2 metres.

products.name: Pandorea jasminoides Lady Di Bower Vine
products.description: Pandorea Lady Di is a medium sized vigorous climber with lush bright green foliage and large clusters of pure white bell shaped flowers with a delicate fragrance during summer. A year-round screen, great for unsightly fences, pergolas and walls, or cascade over a retaining wall or banking. Plant in full sun or part shade with well drained soil. Surprisingly hardy in just about all climates except freezing. Prefers neutral to acid pH, and is easily maintained with a good pruning after flowering. If need be, because it can be vigorous, trim or cut back at other times of the year too. Pandorea Lady Di can grow to a height of 3-5m.

products.name: Grevillea jenkinsii, Spider Flower
products.description: Grevillea Jenkinsii is a densely foliaged shrub with broad soft grey-greenish leaves. From Winter to Spring it bears a profusion of red spider like flowers. The dense foliage of this Australian native plant makes it ideal for hedges. Suitable for shrubberies and general garden use. Grows well in a sunny position in well drained soil. Tolerates drought, light frost and poor soils. Prune after flowering to maintain compact growth. Grows to a height of 1m high and 1m wide. Caution: skin and eye irritant.

products.name: Agapanthus Silver Baby
products.description: gapanthus Silver Baby is an evergreen small clumping Agapanthus with narrow leaves up to 20cm in height. It produces dainty flowers with a white throat and pale blue outer petals on long stems to 30cm high. When mass planted, the flowers look steely silver. Silver Baby is ideal for borders and around tubs, containers and trees or to edge pathways or driveways. Prefers a full sun to semi-shaded position, easy to grow, hardy and thrives in most conditions requiring minimum maintenance. Agapanthus Silver Baby will grow to a height of 30cm and a width of 40cm.

products.name: Acacia cognata Limelight (PBR) Standard
products.description: Acacia cognata Limelight PBR is a prominent grafted standard feature plant that is suitable for any garden or landscape. It is equipped with a compact weeping habit and produces soft decorative foliage in a brilliant lime green shade. The pendulous leaves are the focus for this plant as it does not flower, and is renowned for its lush display of foliage all year round. Fantastic for patio pots and as a focal point in the garden. This variety is also widely used in commercial plantings for creating contrast with great effect. Plant in well draining soils with full to partial sun exposure. Minimal maintenance required, use a native slow release fertiliser during spring and water occasionally during hot periods. Hardy, drought and frost tolerant. Acacia cognata Limelight will grow to a height of 1.8m and a width of 1m. Please note: Acacia Cognata Limelight Standards needs extra care when planting. In ideal locations, protected from wind, with good drainage and regular consistent watering this plant will look stunning in the landscape.

products.name: Westringia fruticosa
products.description: Westringia fruticosa is a hardy fast growing shrub of simple and neat appearance that is easy to grow and long lived. Fruticosa has grey to dark green foliage and small lightly scented white to palest mauve flowers that bloom throughout most of the year but mainly spring to summer. Westringia fruticosa is useful as a specimen plant or can we used for screening or hedging. The height can be maintained at a lower height if a formal trimmed hedge is required. Idea for coastal planting or areas exposed to wind or other harsh conditions. Will grow in full sun or part shade in most soil conditions and is very salt hardy and drought tolerant once established. Will also tolerate slight frosts. Grows to 1.5m high and 1.5m wide.

products.name: Triangle Palm
products.description: Neodypsis decaryi - Triangle Palm A hardy palm with strong upright grey-green leaves reaching 3-5m long. Distinctive three sided triangle shaped trunk. Generally grown as an outdoor specimen in warmer climates, where they require humidity, adequate moisture and a well drained position. Used widely for landscaping around pools, buildings, patio feature plants, parks and gardens. Keep leaves free from dust. feed with a slow release fertiliser as required. Adequate warmth, filtered light and humidity also required.

products.name: Tractor Seat Plant
products.description: Ligularia dentata reniformis, commonly known as Tractor Seat is an outstanding clump forming foliage plant with large kidney shaped glossy green leaves that resemble a tractor seat. During summer, long stems of yellow daisy-like flowers rise above the foliage. An excellent plant for tropical style gardens, pots, containers and mass plantings.The tractor seat plant is winter dormant and prefers to be planted in well drained, moist soils in a sheltered area. Thrives in a full sun to partly shaded position. Apply a slow release fertiliser once a year to promote healthy new growth. Ligularia dentata reniformis can grow up to 1m high and 1m wide.

products.name: Blue Ice Cypress
products.description: Cupressus Blue Ice is a fast growing symmetrical, evergreen conifer with blue foliage. In winter the foliage has a silver fleck. An excellent screening or hedging plant for the home garden. Prefers a sunny well drained position. Can be used in many garden or landscape situations such as lining feature walls or fences, formal gardens, paths and driveways. Mulch well to suppress weeds and conserve moisture, Trim as required and fertilise every spring. Cupressus Blue Ice will grow to a height of 5m and a width of 3m.

products.name: Pittosporum Miss Muffett
products.description: A compact, spreading shrub with highly ornamental, deep green, glossy leaves and small, perfumed flowers from spring through autumn. Ideal for general garden use and suitable for background planting, Thrives in a sunny to partly shaded position in well-drained soil, Grows to a height of 1m and 2m wide.

products.name: Viburnum  Quick Fence  PBR Sweet Viburnum
products.description: Viburnum Quick Fence has a dense, upright growth habit with large glossy mid-green leaves. This hedge produces white flowers during late spring, followed by small red fruit. If you want a quick screen then Quick Fence is the one to use as it is great for screening and hedging. It is tolerant of most soil types and conditions, however prefers a sunny to partly shaded position with well-drained soil. Once established it is tolerant of light frost and moderate cold. Use a slow release fertiliser in spring and prune as required. Viburnum Quick Fence will grow to a height of 4m and a width of 2.5m.

products.name: Euonymus Green Rocket
products.description: Euonymus Green Rocket is a fast-growing, evergreen hedging plant with a very upright habit, making it perfect for narrow areas or low boundary hedges. The neat, glossy dark green foliage is the ideal contrast against your other bedding plants and will add form and structure to any garden style. The oval leaves have a serrated edge, adding to the attractive appearance. Euonymus Green Rocket, as it's name suggests, is fast, fast-growing! It is also hardy, low maintenance and can be used in coastal areas. Euonymus Green Rocket prefers full sun to part shade position and tolerates periods of dryness and frost. Mulch and water well until the plant is established and prune as required to maintain the desired shape. Happy in almost any soil type. Fertilise with Osmocote Slow Release in early autumn. Dimensions: 1m high x 0.5m wide Sunlight: Full Sun / Part Sun

products.name: Apricot Divinity
products.description: A heavy fruit bearer, Apricot Divinity has a very attractive fruit with a slightly red blush. Apricots are nutritious fruit, high in Vitamin A with an incredibly sweet, juicy flavour. This particular variety is also self-pollinating. Apricot Divinity fruit matures early in the season late December to early January. Apricot Divinity will make an excellent addition to any garden, its foliage can provide screening or can be used as a single feature tree. This variety is susceptible to early frost but is generally drought tolerant. Plant in a well drained soil with full to partial sun exposure. Water well and keep soils moist until the tree is established. Use a slow release fertiliser when planting and again after new growth appears. Prune if desired as this will encourage new healthy growth. Apricot Divinity can grow to a height and width of 4 metres.

products.name: Westringia dampieri
products.description: A tough, hardy Australian native sometimes known as Shore Westringia, Westringia Dampieri is a compact form with grey/green foliage and produces white flowers with purple tinges between June and January. Native to the coastal regions from Carnarvon and most of the coast to the Nullabor, Dampieri can handle salt spray making it suitable for coastal or poolside gardens as well as inland gardens/landscapes. It also naturally grows on limestone cliffs, so it suits alkaline soils. A very hardy and low water use plant, Dampieri is great for low maintenance landscaping. Plant in full sun on well-drained to sandy soils. Tip prune in early Spring or after flowering to increase shrub density. Can grow to height of 1.5m and a width of 1m.

products.name: Spanish Iris / Fortnight Lily
products.description: Dietes bicolour is an evergreen perennial grown for its attractive, yellow, iris-like flowers. These flowers sit high above the lime green, sword-shaped leaves which form in large clumps. Dietes flower continuously over long periods in spring and summer, providing prolonged colour to any garden or landscape. Dietes bicolour is a versatile plant that can be used for borders, water gardens, mass plantings and is also well suited to patio pots and containers. Plant Dietes bicolour in an area of full sun to part shade, with well drained soil that is rich in organic material. Once established, Dietes bicolour is quite hardy. Dietes bicolour is waterwise and low maintenance. Fertilise occasionally and water during dry spells. Do not remove flower stems as they continue to flower for several years. Dietes bicolour can grow to a height and width of 1 metre.

products.name: African Iris
products.description: Also known as the African Iris, Dietes vegetata is a grass-like plant that grows in a tight clump of narrow, sword-like leaves. During spring and summer, this variety blooms white iris-like flowers, marked with yellow and purple.. Dietes vegetata is a versatile plant that can be used for borders, water gardens, mass plantings and is also well suited to patio pots and containers. Plant Dietes vegetata in an area of full sun to part shade, with well drained soil that is rich in organic material. Once established, Dietes vegetata is quite hardy. Dietes vegetata is a waterwise, low maintenance. Fertilise occasionally and water during dry spells. Do not remove flower stems as they continue to flower for several years.

products.name: Japanese maple Acer palmatum
products.description: Acer palmatum 'Dissectum Atropurpureum' is a delicate ornamental tree that adds sensational colour to any garden. With its soft lace like leaves and the distinctive foliage colour of deep red/purple shades in spring turning orange then crimson in autumn. Acer palmatum 'Dissectum Atropurpureum' is a grafted tree so it will never outgrow it's surroundings. A perfect feature tree, especially if you have a Japanese style or formal garden. Its rounded, compact habit makes it a perfect focal point for a small garden, particularly in a container, courtyard or patio, or try it alongside a pond, where its sculptural shape will be reflected in the water. Plant in an area sheltered from strong winds and the hot afternoon sun. The Japanese maple likes moist but well draining soil on the acidic side and is full sun to shade tolerant. Mulch to retain moisture and protect roots. Fertilize in spring and autumn. Pruning should not be required.

products.name: Hydrangea Glowing Alps
products.description: Hydrangea Glowing Alps is a showy red/ green flowering Hydrangea. Hydrangea Glowing Alps is perfect for decorative containers in outdoor entertaining areas or courtyards, cottage and formal gardens, as a beautiful backdrop for flowering annuals or in any semi-shaded area you may need a splash of colour. Keep out of direct sunlight, otherwise Hydrangeas may burn. Hydrangea Glowing Alps also makes a beautiful cut flower for a vase indoors. Prefers a rich to average garden soil and kept moist but well-drained. Application of a slow-release fertilizer when required is always beneficial as well as light trim to maintain shape after flowering. Hydrangea Glowing Alps will grow to 1m x 1m.

products.name: Snow Pear
products.description: This very attractive deciduous ornamental pear has a graceful upright growth habit. Its silvery grey foliage throughout spring and summer adds great contrast to any garden, turning into a stunning display of red in autumn. Spring will shower you with prolific pretty white flowers. Produces mildly sour fruit that can be eaten raw or cooked. Ideal to grow in the home garden. Prefers an open sunny position in well drained soil. products.name: Daphne Perfume Princess PBR
products.description:

Large blooms of pretty pink flowers release an intense perfume with soft citrus undertones during winter and spring. Plant in the garden, near a window, doorway or path to enjoy the aroma. Prefers a sunny or semi-shaded, frost-free position with well-drained soil. Once established, it requires occasional attention and should only be pruned lightly. For best results, apply a handful of slow-release fertiliser after flowering. Daphne Perfume Princess PBR will grow to a height of 1.2m and a width of 1m.
Daphne Perfume Princess for sale Perth

products.name: Gaura Pixie Pink
products.description: Gaura 'Pixie Pink' is an exquisite perennial featuring delightful pink blooms that gracefully sway on slender stems, evoking the image of butterflies in mid-flight. This compact variety boasts a height of 60cm and a spread of 50cm, forming a neat and tidy mound, perfect for enhancing containers, borders, and smaller garden spaces. The lance-shaped, velvety green leaves provide a beautiful contrast to the abundance of stunning blossoms. From late spring through early autumn, 'Pixie Pink' puts on a show, attracting essential pollinators like bees and butterflies. Flourishing in sunny locations with well-draining soil, this plant is remarkably low-maintenance, requiring only regular deadheading to ensure continuous blooming throughout the season.

products.name: Photinia Thin Red
products.description: Photinia Thin Red is the perfect plant for hedging those narrow garden beds or tight spots if you are limited in space. The beautiful red new growth will change to a deep, glossy green as the new foliage comes through. Clusters of small white flowers can be seen in mid to late spring adding a lovely contrast. Photinia Thin Red prefers full sun to part shade and tolerates most soil types—plant in a well-mulched garden (chunky mulch is recommended). Maintain regular watering until established. Fertilizing yearly with slow-release fertiliser will keep them happy and healthy. Prune yearly or twice per year for a more tidy hedge. Photinia Thin Red will tolerate mild frost once established. Hardy and relatively low maintenance. Prune as required to promote new growth and maintain shape. Dimensions400cm high x 60cm wide

products.name: Upright Elephant Ear

It is a great foliage feature plant for tropical gardens and indoor spaces. Perfect for decorative pots and containers. Plant in a partly shaded, warm and humid position in the garden or in a well lit position indoors. Water moderately but do not over water. Caution: toxic to animals; skin and eye irritant. Alocasia wentii will grow to a height of 1.5m and a width of 1.5m.

products.name: Rottnest Island Pine
products.description: Callitris preissii is a low-maintenance, evergreen conifer tree with a dense and slender habit. The branching foliage is grey-green and scale-like, each leaf is typically 2-4mm long. Brown globular seed pods are produced throughout the year. Preissii makes an excellent shade tree, windbreak and screening specimen. For optimum results, position in full sun to partly shaded position with well-drained sandy soil. The growth rate of pressii varies depending on the soil type and environmental conditions. Ideal for open windy sites and front-line coastal conditions. Keep moist during dry weather until the root system is established. Mulching will help to preserve moisture within the soil. Callitris preissii will grow to a height of 10-20m and a width of 5-8m.

products.name: Viburnum tinus Anvi
products.description: Viburnum tinus Anvi is a versatile, evergreen shrub of large, rich green, shiny leaves that are dense and leathery. Extra large clusters of snow white flowers bloom profusely and cover the plant from winter through to late spring. The flowers open from pink buds and are followed by deep, purple-blue berries. An ideal hedge or screening plant, it is excellent for blocking out unsightly views r creating privacy. Viburnum tinus Anvi is also suitable as a small speciemen tree for smaller gardens. Plant an area of full sun to part shade with moist, well drained soils. Once established, Anvi is low maintenance, frost tolerant and will tolerate a range of soils and conditions. Light pruning after flowering is beneficial. Apply mulch to help with soil moisture retention. Viburnum tinus Anvi can grow to a height and width of 3 metres.

products.name: Ornamental Pear
products.description: Pyrus Winter Glow is a highly ornamental, deciduous tree with an upright, vase-shaped growth habit. A key highlight of this specimen is the vibrant autumn foliage and the addition of extended foliage through to winter, hence the name. With tones of bright red, Winter Glow provides an alternative foliage display during the colder months. During spring large displays of white flowers appear on the bare branches. An ideal tree for providing shade or a feature in street plantings, parks or large residential gardens. They look spectacular when lined through narrow streets or avenues. Plant in an area of full sun, with humus rich and well drained soils. This particular variety is highly disease resistant, as well as tolerant of wind damage and is relatively low maintenance. Water well until established. Use a good quality mulch to retain moisture. Pyrus Winter Glow can grow to a height of 12m and a width of 4m.

products.name: Indian Hawthorn
products.description: Rhaphiolepis Snow Maiden is a tough, low growing evergreen shrub with high disease tolerance and dark green/bronze foliage. This long-flowering shrub produces white blooms through winter and spring. Ideal for low hedges, pots and garden bed borders. Snow Maiden is salt tolerant and also ideal to plant around pools. Rhaphiolepis Snow Maiden can grow up to 1m high and 1m wide.

products.name: Tibouchina Carol Lynne
products.description: Tibouchina 'Carol lyn' is an evergreen shrub with large purple flowers and striking white stamens forming a white star in the center of the flower when fully opened. This Tibouchina flowers twice a year with sporadic flowering at other times of the year. Leaves are light green colour with tiny little hairs all over giving it a velvet appearance. Carol Lyn is an ideal specimen or screening plant for any protected garden. Carol Lyn will benefit from a light prune and fertilizer after flowering. Tibouchina 'Carol Lyn' will grow to 1.5m high x 1m wide.

products.name: Bird of Paradise
products.description: Commonly known as the Bird of Paradise, Strelitzia reginae is a large, evergreen plant that produces long-stalked leaves with striking orange and blue flowers that resemble an exotic bird. These stunning flowers appear on long stems during spring and summer and provide a stunning contrast against the blue-green foliage. Strelitzia reginae will add a definite tropical-paradise feel to any garden or landscape. Strelitzia reginae is an ideal feature plant in the garden bed, or pots and containers. The flowers and foliage are also used in flower arrangements. Plant in an area of full sun to partial shade, with well-drained soil. Strelitzia reginae is relatively low maintenance. Keep soils moist during the growing season, and through extended hot periods. Strelitzia reginae can grow to a height of 2 m and a width of 1.5 m.

products.name: Sweet Viburnum
products.description: Viburnum odoratissimum also known as Sweet Viburnum, is an evergreen, medium to large shrub, of large, rich green, shiny leaves that are dense and leathery. In spring, large clusters of sweetly scented, tiny white blooms are produced, followed by red berries. A trendy plant due to its fast-growing habit. It is an ideal hedge or screening plant, as it will block out unsightly views, creating privacy. Sweet Viburnum is also suitable as a small specimen tree for smaller gardens—plant in an area of full sun to part shade with moist, well-drained soils. Once established, Viburnum tinus is low maintenance, frost tolerant and will tolerate various soils and conditions. Light pruning after flowering is beneficial. Apply mulch to help with soil moisture retention. Viburnum odoratissimum can grow to a height and width of 4 m.s.

products.name: Cupressus Swanes Gold Conifer
products.description: Cupressus Swanes Gold is an evergreen conifer with golden green foliage and grows in a dense, upright, columnar manner. Cupressus Swanes Gold thrives in moist, well draining soils, planted in full sun areas, although it can adapt to suit semi shaded positions. Water regularly until established, Cupressus Swanes Gold will appreciate a feed in Spring with a slow release fertiliser. Frost hardy, Cupressus Swanes Gold requires low maintenance. Prune as desired to encourage a more compact growth. Cupressus Swanes Gold will grow to a height of 5m and maximum width of 1m, although width will vary depending on conditions.

products.name: Grevillea olivacea yellow
products.description: Grevillea olivacea yellow is a Western Australian native. Commonly known as the 'olive Grevillea due to the shape and colour of the foliage. This showy Grevillea is very popular due to its waterwise properties. Olivacea yellow has dense, deep-green foliage and displays a profusion of spider-like yellow flowers produced for an extended period from winter through to late spring. This native has an upright growing habit with densely packed foliage. The Grevillea is perfect for attracting birds to your garden. This particular Grevillea is ideal as a hedge, perfect for your native garden or as a member of your general garden. Popular with landscapers for mass plantings and ideal as a screen. Grevilleas prefer full sun, are hardy and drought tolerant and will grow in a large range of soil types, including coastal areas. Will tolerate periods of dryness once established, but will benefit from deep watering occasionally in dry weather. Olivacea yellow is low maintenance although pruning after flowering maintains the desired shape and compact growth. Feeding with a low phosphorus controlled release fertiliser in early spring or late summer is beneficial. Mulch to suppress weeds and retain soil moisture. Grevillea olivacea yellow will grow to a height of 2.5 to 4m high and 2.5 - 4m wide.

products.name: Liriope Emerald Cascade (PBR) Weeping Liriope
products.description: Emerald Cascade' is a stand out tough-as-nails garden performer, tolerating a wide range of adverse conditions. Not only will Emerald Cascade tolerate extended periods of dryness in situations such as beneath the eaves of a home, or under the canopy of a tree, it also does well with minimal care inside the home or office. 'Emerald Cascade' has dramatic weeping emerald green foliage, and produces cobalt blue berries in the spring and summer. It is non-invasive, spreading slowly to form graceful thick mounds of foliage, and makes for a dense ground cover when planted en masse. It's for this reason that it lends itself perfectly to low maintenance landscapes, in both the domestic and public open space environments. Emerald Cascade is without a doubt, one of the toughest plants available for the landscape and will find itself at home in most situations. Extremely low water requirements once established, requiring only occasional deep watering during extended periods of heat. Emerald Cascade grows well in most soil types and is low maintenance. No pruning required. Simply feed in spring with a slow release general purpose fertiliser according to manufacturer directions for optimum results Small gardens, patios and courtyards. Indoors, requiring low light and is very tough. Mass planting as a low maintenance ground cover. Planting beneath open canopy trees. Ideal for edging garden beds or paved surfaces (plant 20cm apart). Use around poolside landscapes and entertainment areas to add a lush atmosphere.

products.name: Murraya Sweet Privacy (PBR)
products.description: Murraya paniculata Sweet Privacy is the perfect low maintenance screening plant to add to your garden for a bit of extra privacy. This Ozbreed shrub will be sure to impress with its fresh green leaves and dense foliage that produces beautiful white, sweet smelling flowers during spring and summer right through to early autumn. Sweet Privacy prefers a full sun-part shade position in your garden and will benefit from the occasional prune. The great thing about this particular Murraya is that it only requires pruning 2-3 times per year, so a lot less frequently than it's other forms. Murraya Sweet Privacy will grow to around 2.5m High and 1.5m wide. Applying a slow-release fertiliser occasionally, when needed, will keep your Sweet Privacy looking amazing. Sweet Privacy is the perfect screening/hedging plant without all the extra maintenance.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Acmena Red Head (PBR)
products.description: This attractive variety produces glossy emerald foliage with a luscious red new growth that appears in autumn. Acmena's are incredibly popular as a hedging or screening plant suited to most gardens or landscapes. They produce clusters of small white flowers followed by vibrant purple berries which are edible. Acmena smithii Red Head is a very hardy native and does have a strong resistance to psyllids, wind, cold and is also a fire retardant species. Plant Red Head in well-drained to heavy clay soils and exposed to full to part shade. It can be grown as a shrub or an attractive small specimen tree. Red Head is a low-maintenance plant as it has low water requirements. Regular fertilizing will ensure an abundance of new growth. Red Head will grow to a height of 6 m with a width of 2 m.

products.name: Bamboo Palm Chamaedorea seifrizii
products.description: A small palm that produces dark green foliage with deeply divided leaves that appear from clustering bamboo-like stems, hence it is commonly known as the Bamboo Palm. An ideal container plant for indoors, or outdoors in a cool, moist position that is protected from the hot sun and drying winds. Prefers full shade, or indoors with indirect light exposure. Tolerates low levels of humidity and bright indirect light and is relatively low maintenance. During spring and summer, fertilize on a monthly basis. Ensure that enough water is provided based on the amount of light the plant receives. Chamaedorea seifrizii can grow to a height of 3 ms and a width of 2 m.

products.name: Correa alba
products.description: Correa alba is a very adaptable evergreen shrub with thick, rounded grey-green leaves. Very pretty white flowers from late summer to early winter. A versatile shrub that tolerates a wide variety of conditions. Plant in coastal, native and mixed garden beds, very effective when mass planted. Bird attracting. Tolerates a wide range of soils but for best results plant in fertile, well-drained soil in full sun to part shade. Tip prune to promote bushiness. Correa alba will grow to a height of .5-2m and a width of 1-2m.

products.name: Viburnum Coppertop (PBR)
products.description:
Viburnum Coppertop is an amazing plant suitable for hedging and has gleaming green leaves with lustrous bronze/ copper/ maroon new shoots making it a standout feature in any garden. in the spring, Coppertop also has a white, fragrant flower that can be a filler in cut flower arrangements, and is also butterfly-attracting. Coppertop prefers well-drained soil and can grow in full sun or partial shade, as Coppertop is heat and drought resistant once established. Viburnum Coppertop is perfect as a low hedge but is also ideal for landscaping or in decorative containers on the balcony or terrace for those limited by space. if you do a light midsummer pruning, you will get a second flush of colourful leaves that last into late autumn.

products.name: Olive Tree
products.description: Add a Tuscan, Mediterranean vibe to your garden by planting an olive tree such as Swan Hill. Swan Hill is smaller growing than other varieties and is considered a slow grower, if left unpruned can grow as tall as it is wide. They can also be used as a medium-sized hedges, espalier or in large containers. Swan Hill is relatively low maintenance and grows well in a sunny to partly shaded position, with well-draining soil. products.name: Peach Dwarf Sunset
products.description: Dwarf Sunset is a compact growing Peach variety that produces full sized orange to yellow fruit with sweet white flesh, ideal for plucking straight off the branch and eating fresh straightaway. The red-green foliage and the double pink blossoms provide a stunning all-round tree. products.name: Nectarine Dwarf Sunset (PBR)
