Sweet white fleshed red skinned fruit appear mid-season and are ideal for eating fresh and for using in cooking. Dwarf Sunset is absolutely perfect for pots on the patio, balcony or deck. Prefers an open, sunny position with well-drained soil. For best results keep moist until established and mulch well to conserve soil moisture. Prune after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. The plant can handle frost during winter, however, if you are in an area that is prone to late frosts you would be better suited to leave it in a protected environment until flowering has finished to ensure you get the best fruit returns. The Sunset Nectarine is 100% self fertile, which means NO pollinators are required to set fruit. Nectarine Dwarf Sunset will grow to a height of 1-1.5m and a width of 0.8m.

products.name: Rosemary Blue Lagoon
products.description: Rosemary Tuscany Blue serves as both a kitchen herb and an ornamental plant that adds beauty to any perennial garden. The most popular of all Rosemary varieties, Tuscany Blue blooms deep blue flowers in winter that contrast beautifully with its fresh, highly fragrant, broad mid-green leaves. Due to its sturdy upright growth habit, Tuscany Blue makes for an ideal hedge for any backyard garden. It is excellent for adding a Mediterranean feel or letting it grow unrestrained in your veggie patch, picking as you require. These attractive herbs have a multitude of uses for their foliage and flowers, like flavoring meats for that Sunday leg of ham. Some people have been known to use aromatic essential oil for other purposes like relaxing aching joints and even as an antiseptic. Growing best in a hot, dry, sunny position with moist well-drained soil, it is drought tolerant once established and prefers to stay fairly dry in winter. Prune after flowering to maintain a bushy, compact habit. Rosmarinus officinalis Tuscany Blue grows to a height of 1 - 1.5 m and a width of 1- 2 ms.

products.name: Purple Fountain Grass
products.description: Pennisetum advena rubrum is a hardy perennial grass that blooms an abundance of fluffy arching maroon-pink plumes through the warmer months of the year. The flowers sit high above the burgundy-toned foliage and display a stunning color. Pennisetum advena rubrum is fast growing, an ideal border and can be used in garden beds as well as containers. This variety has also been shown to help with erosion control on embankments. Thriving in fertile, free-draining soils, in full sun to part shade positions. Once established, it is a low-maintenance plant, tolerant of high temperatures, humidity, and wind and able to withstand light frost Fertilise with a slow release once a year in spring. Prune back every few years to encourage new growth. Pennisetum advena rubrum can grow to a height of 1m and a width of 70 cm.

products.name: Asian Pear
products.description: A popular Asian pear variety producing, round apple like fruit with russet brown skin and mildly sweet, crisp white flesh. The fruit is ideal for plucking straight off the branch and eating fresh, cooking in desserts and for preserving. he tree itself is deciduous with a dense, upright, spreading habit. Ideal for planting in backyards, large pots and containers and for training as an espalier. Plant in an area of full sun, although they can tolerate partial sun. This variety prefers light, rich soils with good drainage but will tolerate heavier clay-rich soils. Chojuro requires moderate maintenance. Protect from pear and cherry slug. Mulch well to conserve moisture. Prune well after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. It will benefit from cross-pollination, including varieties such as Nijisseiki. Nashi Chojuro can grow to a height of 5 m and a width of 4 m.

products.name: Plum Mariposa Semi-Dwarf
products.description: This variety is a dwarf version of the popular Mariposa plum. Plum Mariposa Semi-Dwarf produces medium to large heart-shaped fruit that has dark red speckled skin and dark red flesh with an excellent sweet, juicy flavor. The fruit is ideal for juice, jams, stewing or plucking straight off the branch and eating fresh. The fruit is soft when fully ripe. The tree itself is deciduous with green foliage that turns yellow before falling in autumn followed by red and white flowers during spring. An ideal specimen for those with small to medium gardens. Plant in an open, sunny position in well drained soil. For best results keep moist until established and mulch well to conserve moisture. Plum Mariposa Semi-Dwarf requires moderate maintenance; prune after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. Mariposa Semi Dwarf Plum can grow to a height and width of 2 meters.

products.name: Malus Profusion Crab Apple
products.description: Malus 'Profusion' is a beautiful, upright but small-growing, deciduous tree with a spreading, rounded habit that is a very showy feature when in bloom. After flowering the shiny green foliage creates the ideal shade tree for smaller or larger gardens alike. Flowering profusely from a young age Malus Profusion will be rewarding from the outset. Opening from deep red buds, the masses of fragrant, deep-pink flowers will blanket the entire tree in pretty clusters of deep pink flowers from mid-spring, followed by the small fruit which is deep crimson to purple in colour and can be left as an ornamental intertest or used to make jams or jellies. Malus Profusion's new foliage has a coppery tinge before turning to a lush green, and the foliage is rounded, glossy, and attractive through the season. Malus Profusion can be pruned immediately after the fruiting period is complete if you wish to shape the tree. It is not a tree that demands regular pruning, so maintenance is low. Malus Profusion is also a good cross-polinator for several varieties of apple. Prefers deep, well-drained soils in full sun, though a little shade throughout the day is well tolerated. Fertilise with an all-purpose fertiliser when required. This flowering crabapple is hardy and has a good disease resistance.

products.name: Apricot
products.description: Apricot 'Fireball' has clean, smooth skin shaded dark orange. Apricots are a nutritious fruit, high in Vitamin A with an incredibly sweet, juicy flavor. This particular variety is also self-pollinating. Apricot Fireball will make an excellent addition to any garden and can be used as a single feature tree. This variety is susceptible to early frost but is generally drought tolerant. Plant in well-drained soil with full to partial sun exposure. Water well and keep soils moist until the tree is established. Use a slow-release fertilizer when planting and again after new growth appears. Prune if desired as this will encourage new healthy growth. Although Apricot Fireball is self-fertile, it will benefit from cross-pollination from another apricot or plum, and will result in greater fruit production. The fruit matures over November to December, providing a refreshing treat over the summer months. Apricot Fireball can grow to a height of 4 m with a width of 3 m.

products.name: Apple Red Delicious Semi Dwarf
products.description: Apple Red Delicious Semi Dwarf is a dwarf deciduous specimen, producing excellent crops of bright red, large crunchy apples. The flesh is greenish white and has a crisp texture. They are great to eat straight off the tree. Produces bright green foliage and blush white blooms during spring. Suitable for large gardens, orchards, paddocks and large pots. To pollinate, plant alongside a Granny Smith, Pink Lady or a Red Fuji. Can handle warm and cool temperatures and is tolerant of periods of frost. Apple Red Delicious Semi Dwarf can grow to 3m high and and 2m wide.

products.name: Almond Self Pollinating
products.description: Almonds are a large papershell nut that have a sweet flavour and are broad and oval in shape. Self pollinating variety that fruits early March. An upright growth habit and a reliable cropper. Almonds are high in fibre and nutrients, as well as being cholestrol free. Eat fresh or roasted. Harvest when the shell starts to split open. Plant in a warm, protected area in well drained soil. Make sure you plant the bud union above the soil. Water in well and keep moist until established. Fertilise when planting and again when new growth appears. prune when planting. Almond self pollinating will grow to 2m high and a width of 2m.

products.name: Coprosma Sahara TM Ruby (PBR) Mirror Bush
products.description: The bright, glossy foliage of the Coprosma range makes them a standout in any situation. Safari Ruby has stunning red foliage with a chocolate brown centre, which can change with the seasons. Safari Ruby can be planted in almost any garden or landscape with a well-drained soil in a sunny to part-shade location. They will also cope with high wind and salt spray, making them coastal-friendly. Safari Ruby will make an attractive hedge along that pathway, mass planted on a dry sunny slope, or shaped as small balls or a desired shape. Ideal on decks and patios, or by the pool due to minimal leaf-drop. Sahara Ruby will grow to 1m high and wide, forming an upright mound of dense foliage. This very versatile shrub can be shaped or pruned to encourage greater density. Perfect for low hedges. Coprosma have no issues with disease or pests, and an application of slow release fertiliser before spring is beneficial. Width100 cmdHeight100 cm

products.name: Azalea Mrs Kint
products.description: Azalea Mrs Kint is a fairly compact evergreen shrub with bright pink flowers with a white edge and mid to deep green foliage. Best grown in full sun or part shade in humus rich, well drained, slightly acidic soil in pots on a shady patio or under planting for trees and shrubs or as a border. Protect from frosts. Fertilise regularly to maintain continued flowering. Mulch and prune after flowering. Azalea Mrs Kint will grow to a height of 1m and a width of 0.6m.

products.name: Swamp Lily
products.description: Crinum pedunculatum, is a large lily with long grey/green leaves up to 2m long. Clusters of fragrant, spidery white flowers appear in summer. Swamp Lily is a very versatile and hardy plant. It makes a great feature plant for the home garden. It can be grown in a wide range of conditions from full sun to half shade or more. It tolerates poor drainage, clay soils and can be planted successfully under established trees with large canopies. It's suitable for coastal areas, tolerates frosts and will flower well when in containers. Benefits from summer watering. Protect from snails and slugs. Swamp Lily will grow to a height of 2-3m and a width of 2-3m.

products.name: Cousin It
products.description: Casuarina glauca Cousin It is an unusual and extremely tough Australian native mounding groundcover featuring deep green cascading auricular-shaped foliage. Effectively covers unsightly pipes, stumps, and other ground obstacles and suppresses weeds. A fantastic feature for pots and mass planting in the garden, where it can cascade over walls and embankments. For best results, plant Cousin It in a sunny position. It is adaptable to many different soil types and tolerates periods of drought, light frost and coastal conditions; however, it performs best in moist, well-drained soil. Water regularly until the plant is established. During the warmer months, apply a wetting agent to help retain moisture. Lightly prune to maintain a tidy habit and apply a general-purpose fertiliser when required. Casuarina glauca Cousin It will grow to a height of 10cm and a width of 1m.

products.name: Olive Tree Olea Nevadillo Blanco
products.description: This Spanish variety of olive is prized for the high oil content of the fruit. They are a reliable, heavy and constant cropper and ripens early to mid-season. It is also a dual-purpose olive, suitable for the table as well as oil. Fruit is ready for harvest from March through to September. An ideal addition to garden and landscapes as an attractive specimen, street or shade trees. They can also be used as a medium-sized hedge. Thriving in warm regions with cool winters. Extended dry, hot conditions during months will encourage fruit development. Nedavillo Blanco is relatively low maintenance, drought-tolerant and easily adaptable to coastal conditions. Olea Nedavillo Blanco can grow to a height of 9 m and a width of 6 m.

products.name: Sweet Viburnum Emerald Lustre
products.description: A fast growing evergreen shrub Viburnum Emerald Lustre has large leathery bright green leaves and small fragrant white flowers in late spring followed by oblong red fruits ripening to black. Emerald Lustre makes a perfect accent foliage plant in the garden and tolerates full sun and part shade and prefers to grow in friable well drained soil. Prune regulary to shape. Ideal fast growing lush hedge if kept to shape or large screening plant. Viburnum Emerald Lustre grows to a height of 4m and 3m wide.

products.name: LIlly Pilly Syzygium Straight and Narrow (PBR)
products.description: If you are looking for a narrower hedging Lilly pilly this could be the one. Syzygium Straight and Narrow is a narrow upright, bushy and compact variety which is also psyllid resistant. A beautiful dense shrub, the green foliage has bronze tips and bares the fluffy flowers typical of most lilly pilly, and these are followed by the fruit which is a pink to red and adds another interest to this lovely plant. Ideal for along fence-lines and narrow driveways they can also make a nice topiary. Perfect as a potted statement plant or in courtyards and larger sculptured landscapes alike. Syzygium Straight and Narrow prefers a moist well draining soil, and likes to be well mulched with a chunky mulch and will tolerate dry periods once established, and also cold periods. Fertilizing with a slow-release fertilizer in spring should keep Straight and Narrow looking healthy and happy, and a light prune twice yearly will keep it tidy, or less frequently for a wider screen plant.

products.name: Weeping Mulberry, Morus alba
products.description: 'Weeping Mulberry' forms long, pendulous branches that bow down to the ground. These branches are covered in large green, glossy leaves and during autumn they turn yellow-green. Morus alba 'Pendula' is a tough, standout tree suited to park and garden plantings and is often seen near shopping malls and avenue plantings. Plant Morus alba 'Pendula' in an area of full sun to part shade, with well-drained soils. Once established Weeping Mulberry tolerates a wide range of site conditions including dry and coastal areas. This Weeping Mulberry is waterwise, relatively low maintenance and will respond well to heavy pruning. Morus alba 'Pendula' is normally grafted just under 2m high and can grow to a height of 3 m and a width of 4 m.

products.name: Indian Hawthorn
products.description: Rhaphiolepis indica Rajah is a low growing shrub with glossy, dark green foliage. This long flowering shrub produces pink blooms from autumn through to late spring. Ideal for hedging, pots and garden beds. Prefers a sunny to partly shaded position and can withstand coastal conditions. Low maintenance and tolerant to frost aswell as salt, making it ideal to plant around pools. Rhaphiolepis indica Rajah can grow up to 1m high and 1m wide.

products.name: Raindrop Peperomia
products.description: RAINDROP PEPEROMIA 'Peperomia polybotrya" also known as Coin-Leaf Peperomia is a small compact shrub with bright, glossy green "raindrop" shaped foliage with white flowers. The glossy green, thick, heart-shaped leaves are beautiful and the plant remains pretty compact so it is great for smaller spaces! Easy care, it makes a delightful addition to your houseplant collection. It is a well sought-after indoor succulent growing to 45 cm tall - best grown indoors with in-direct sunlight. Fertilize with a balanced liquid fertilizer every couple of months and allow the soil to partially dry between watering.

products.name: Japanese Box
products.description: Buxus microphylla japonica is a compact evergreen shrub with bright green, leathery obovate leaves. An excellent specimen shrub for formal gardens, hedging and topiary. Plant as a feature in decorative pots and containers to add lush greenery to a patio setting. This hardy variety excels in warm climates in a full sun to partly shaded position with moist, well-drained soil. Requires regular watering during periods of drought. Prune regularly to maintain compact growth. Buxus microphylla japonica will grow to a height of 2m and a width of 2m.

products.name: Giant Bird of Paradise
products.description:
Giant Bird of Paradise (Strelitzia Nicolai), is a large, evergreen plant producing very long, broad leaves, resembling a palm frond. Large striking bird-like white and dark blue flowers appear during spring and summer - providing a stunning contrast against the bluish-green foliage. Giant Bird of Paradise will add a definite tropical-paradise feel to any garden and makes an ideal feature plant in a garden bed or in large pots or containers. Plant in an area of full sun to part shade, with well-drained soil. Giant Bird of Paradise is relatively low maintenance. Keep the soil moist during the growing season, and through extended hot periods. Shade from direct sunlight in summer, but dry in winter. It can grow to a height of 6 m and a width of 3 m.
Dimensions 4-6m high x 3m wide
Sunlight Full Sun / Part Sun
Flower Colour Blue / Purple / White
Foliage Colour Blue / Green
Flowering Season Spring / Summer

products.name: Lilly Pilly Tiny Trev PBR
products.description: Tiny Trev PBR is a slow growing, dense native with beautiful bronze glossy leaves that turn deep green. Creamy white flowers turn into edible bright red fruit that can be used in making jam or as a snack. Tiny Trev PBR makes an excellent low hedge and goes great in pots or tubs. Responds well to clipping and prefers a rich, well drained soil, but can tolerate poorer soils. Add compost or peat moss if your soil is sandy. Keep well mulched and feed with blood and bone every spring. Trim after flowering to keep tidy. Syzygium Tiny Trev PBR grows to a height of 1m and a width of 1m.

products.name: African Box
products.description: This small, slow-growing shrub is known for its glossy, aromatic, dark green foliage. Tiny cream toned flowers appear at the base of the leaves during spring. Ideal for hedging, screening or potted in patio containers. . African Box takes full sun to part shade and will tolerate a range of soils and conditions and is drought tolerant once established. African box 'Myrsine Africana' is a low maintenance plant growing to a height of 1.5 metres and a width of 75 centimetres. A regular, light pruning of the tips will encourage a busy growth.

products.name: Callistemon Bottlebrush
products.description:
Callistemon Dawson River Weeper is a tall native Australian endemic from Queensland evergreen shrub/small tree with weeping grey-green foliage. In springtime, bright red bottlebrush flowers create a spectacular display.
Great as a feature tree for small gardens.
 Buy Callistemon 'Dawson River Weeper' Bottlebrushonline now!

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text:
This plant survives in Warm Temperate Climates / Mediterranean Climates. Plant in full to part sun in moist well-drained loamy soils. Water weekly for optimal growth and healthy maintenance. This plant can only survive moderate dry periods but does not fare well in extended drought periods. Light sprinkle or a native fertiliser in small quantities. It can tolerate marginal frost after establishment.
Responds to light pruning after flowering to keep compact. This helps the plant to save resources into making more foliage and flowers.

products.description:
A charming evergreen shrub, Endeavour produces a mass of brilliant crimson bottlebrush flowers during Spring.
It is well suited to coastal and native gardens and works well if used as a shrub, screen and/or a hedge.

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text: This plant survives in Warm Temperate Climates / Mediterranean Climates. For the best flower display grow in full sun, but like most Callistemons, it is adaptable and can be grown in the poorest of soils.

products.name: New Zealand Rock Lily
products.description:
View Fact Sheet
Information courtesy of Plants Growers Australia www.pga.com.au
Arthropodium ‘Te Puna’ is a plant with exceptional garden performance characteristics, growing in dry shade, where it is typically challenging to find suitable plants. ‘Te Puna’ is a dwarf rock lily native to New Zealand. Here in Australia, it performs exceptionally well, rewarding with a mass of white flowers during the spring and summer periods. When planted in shaded areas, the flowers allow for illumination, adding light to the dark corners of the garden. This variety is dainty and will not only provide home gardeners with a hardy tufting plant. It also lends itself to domestic and commercial landscape plantings, where it has proved successful in a wide range of environs, planted under trees, in the shade of buildings and mass-planted around car parks and other open spaces. Generally, no pruning is required. Remove flower stems as they fade to promote more blooms. Fertilise annually with a long-term slow-release fertiliser. Arthropodium Te Puna will grow to a height of 40cm and a width of 50cm.

products.name: Grevillea Honey Wonder
products.description:
This shrubby grevillea attracts birds with its long, dark-golden toothbrush flowers, which appear on the shrub for months of the year. A variegated evergreen, leather, and finely cut foliage give a dense appearance. Cut flowers and foliage are ideal for floral arrangements. Honey Wonder grows to about 2 mtrs in height with a spread of 1.5mtrs and will grow well in most soil conditions & benefits from a fertiliser high in nitrogen in Spring & mid Summer. Water well after pruning and during dry periods. Prune in late winter to encourage flowering.

products.name: Croton Little Mia
products.description: Croton Little Mia is a tropical plant that is grown for the lush, leathery, multi-coloured foliage. Often splashed with vibrant greens, yellow and red. In warm frost-free areas Little Mia can enjoy a sheltered patio or indoor position which makes a wonderful specimen in a feature pot. Also great planted in the garden in a semi-shaded, well-drained position. Keep soil moist in summer & slightly dryer in winter. products.name: Rosemary Portugese Pink
products.description: Rosmarinus Potuguese Pink is both a kitchen herb and an ornamental plant that adds beauty to any perennial garden. Vibrant pink flowers appear in abundance during winter and contrast beautifully with its fresh, highly fragrant, broad mid-green leaves. Due to its sturdy upright growth habit, Portuguese Pink makes for an ideal hedge for any backyard garden. It is excellent for adding a Mediterranean feel or letting it grow unrestrained in your veggie patch, picking as you require. These attractive herbs have a multitude of uses for their foliage and flowers, like flavoring meats for that Sunday leg of ham. Some people have been known to use aromatic essential oil for other purposes such as relaxing aching joints and even as an antiseptic. Growing best in a hot, dry, sunny position with moist well-drained soil. It is drought tolerant once established and prefers to stay fairly dry in winter. Prune after flowering to maintain a bushy, compact habit. Rosmarinus officinalis Portuguese Pink grows to a height of 1 - 1.5 ms and a width of 1 - 2 m. Note: Edible flowers or foliage should be picked fresh from an area that has not been exposed to any gardening chemicals and washed before consumption. Flowers are often intended only as a garnish, and should not be eaten in excess. If you are unsure whether a flower or foliage is edible, do not eat it; instead, consult a Botanist or your health provider.

products.description: With lovely 'powdery-blue' leaves with reddish edges during autumn and winter 'Blue Bird' are excellent as a contrast to your other succulents and ideal in decorative bowls, pots or tubs, and in any garden or rockery. The flowers of 'Blue Bird' are long-lasting, pink-orange in colour, and born on slender stalks up to 25cm tall during spring and early summer. Echeveria are very popular and grow in attractive rosettes and beautiful foliage in a range of colours. Most Echeveria also remain fairly small from a few cm to 30cm in width. Perfect in sunny windows Echeveria 'Blue Bird' is easy to grow and is a hardy succulent. A couple of basics can assist in ensuring this. Try not to leave water sitting in the rosette of leaves as this can cause rot. Removal of dead leaves also reduces the likelihood of the plant becoming a haven for pests. As with all succulents, 'Blue Bird' enjoys plenty of light. Feed with a controlled-release fertilizer in the beginning of the season or weekly with a weak liquid solution. Use a balanced 20-20-20 fertilizer at 1/4 strength on mature plants, and a fertilizer with less nitrogen on young plants.

The Raspberry Fountain is very different from the similarly named "Red Fountain" and should not be confused with each other, view Cordyline Red Fountain in the link here: Cordyline Red Fountain

products.name: Lady Palm
products.description: This very hardy attractive palm is a slow growing multi-stemmed palm which makes a fantastic indoor plant. Rhapis excelsa prefers a moist well-drained soil in a sheltered temperate location but will adapt to a wide range of climates, soils, and environments making for a very versatile specimen. Also known as 'slender lady palm', 'bamboo palm', 'fan palm', finger palm', and 'parlor palm', 'Lady Palm' is the most recognized. In it's natural habitat this palm can reach 14' tall and can form clumps of similar width. Rhapis excelsa bears large thick leaves with blunt tips and wide segments on sturdy canes or stems which are covered with a fibrous sheath of course dark brown fiber. Rhapis excelsa is fairly cold hardy and can tolerate tropical and subtropical temperatures, handling both humid and dry climates. Being a prolific producer of rhizomes adds a fullness to the plant, although growth rate mainly depends on the environment and culture. This lovely 'air-purifying' plant is easy to grow, and possibly the easiest of all palms, tolerating low-light areas better than other palms although it prefers bright, indirect light, so near windows and skylights is preferred. Rhapis excelsa prefers a moist well-drained soil and drying out severely can cause damage to the foliage and tip burn. The best way to prune these palms is to trim off the lower leaves as they age or become discolored. If the new growth dies this usually means that the whole trunk will need to be cut out. It is a sign that the trunk has rotted so the other green leaves will eventually go brown and die. Fertilizer is rarely required as they are so slow growing. If the leaves start to go yellowish it needs some nutrients, so fertilize at half the strength recommended for other plants. Avoid over fertilizing.

products.name: Hydrangea Blueberries and Cream
products.description: Hydrangea Blueberries and Cream has beautiful blue blooms offset by a cluster of light blue flushed buds in the centre. Free-flowering and compact in habit, the blue flowers are beautifully offset by the rich dark green foliage. Welcome it into your home as a flowering houseplant. It is easy to care for: just water well and place it anywhere around the house or on a patio where you wish to enjoy its colour.

products.name: Alstroemeria Peruvian Lilly Rock Roll
products.description: Alstroemeria Rock & Roll PBR is a compact clumping Alstroemeria with masses of brilliant bright red flowers in spring through to autumn making a dramatic contrast to the variagated foliage of creamy yellow fading to white with a green edge. An ideal plant as a specimen plant for containers, borders, garden beds, cottage gardens and cut flowers. Prefers a full sun to part shade position, well drained soil and regular watering. Fertilise in spring and again after flowering. Prune old flower stems from the ground to promote new growth and divide clumps every few years in spring. Alstroemeria Rock & Roll PBR grows to a height of 60cm a width of 70cm.

products.name: Alstroemeria Breakaway Lilly Paola
products.description: Alstroemeria Paola produces masses of crimson and peach bicoloured lily like blooms. This series of Alstroemeria feature compact plants, with excellent branching that will produce a greater array of blooms. In the ground it is an attractive perennial, blooming for several months. Alstroemeria Paola is a wonderful plant to liven up garden beds, or to use as a cut flower as it has an exceptionally long vase life. They can also make a striking mixed border. Fantastic in pots, or grow in a well drained soil in sheltered position. Alstroemeria Paola prefers cool, moist and deep sandy loams with exposure to full to partial sun. Alstroemeria Paola is low maintenance. Mulch soil well, especially in frosty areas. Water regularly in dry weather and fertilise with a plant food high in potassium for best blooms. Alstroemeria Paola grows to a height of 30cm and a width of 40cm.

products.name: Christmas Tree
products.description: Pinus Christmas Star is a form of pine selected to bring the enjoyment of a real Christmas tree to your home, with its dark green, aromatic leaves. Planted in a pot to maintain a compact size, it looks stunning decorate in any home over Christmas and can be kept in a pot for a number of years if adequate care is given. If keeping indoors, ensure that the plant will receive enough light. Pinus Christmas Star can also be planted out in the garden to grow taller and will make a striking feature tree. Keep in a moist, well drained soil that is rich in organic matter, requiring low maintenance. Prune to shape as required and fertilise in spring. Pinus Christmas Star can grow to a height of 8 metres and a width of 3 metres.

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text: This plant needs full sun if planted outdoors. If keeping indoors, ensure that the plant will receive enough light. Keep in moist, well-drained soil that is rich in organic matter. Prune to shape as required and fertilise in spring.

products.name: Plum Santa Rosa
products.description: This variety is considered to be one of the best plums. Santa Rosa is a fast-growing variety, producing large rounded fruit, with a purplish-crimson skin and flavorsome yellow mildly sweet flesh with a red blush just below the skin. The fruit is ideal for juice, jam, stewing, or plucking straight off the branch and eating fresh. The tree itself is deciduous with green foliage that turns yellow before falling in autumn followed by pale blue flowers during spring. An ideal specimen for those with small to medium gardens. Plant in an open, sunny position in well-drained soil. This variety will benefit greatly when a pollinator such as Mariposa, is planted in proximity as this will encourage added fruit development. For best results keep moist until established and mulch well to conserve moisture. Requires moderate maintenance, prune after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. Santa Rosa Plum can grow to a height and width of 4 m.

products.name: Plum Narrabeen
products.description: Plum Narrabeen is a small tree with large round firm fruit through summer, January to February The fruit has red skin and creamy white juicy flesh and can be used for fresh fruit, stewing, and jams - requires a pollinator tree to produce fruit. The first fruit appears when tree is approximatley three years old Grows best in full sun, and is frost tolerant once established Plum Narrabeen grows to a height of 9m high and 7m wide.

products.name: Pear Sensation
products.description: A very attractive Pear variety producing bright red, medium sized fruit with creamy white flesh that is sweet and well flavoured. Prefers an open, sunny position in well drained soil. For best results keep moist until established and mulch well to conserve soil moisture. Prune after harvest to manage branch groth and to prevent overcrowding. Protect from Pear and Cherry slug. Pollinators - Nijisseiki, Beurre Bosc Grows to a height of 12m high and 10m wide.

products.name: Pear Baby Face
products.description: A small cocktail pear. The fruit is all over green in colour with an attractive blush. The fruit is a small ovate pyriform shape, and very sweet. Complimentary to your cheese platter. Pollinator: Packhams triumph. A mid-season Pear variety producing small fruits that have green skin and sweet white flesh. Ideal for eating fresh and for cheese platters. Prefers an open, sunny position in well-drained soil. For best results keep moist unitl established and mulch well to conserve soil moisture. Prune after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. Protect from Pear and Cherry slug. Polinators - Packhams Triumph, Josephine de Malines Grows to a height of 8m high and 4m wide.

products.name: Peach Anzac
products.description: Older style, early maturing peach with some red blush. Pale greenish-white, juicy flesh. Freestone. Suitable for fresh fruit and juice. Self fertile. An early season variety Peach producing heavy crops of large, white fleshed fruit. Ideal for eating fresh. Prefers an open, sunny position in moist, well-drained soil. For best results apply a complete fertiliser in winter and prune after harvest to manage branch growth and to prevent overcrowding. A great assest to any backyard. Spraying to prevent leaf curl is recommended. Self Pollinating Grows to a height of 6m high and 6m wide.

products.name: Nectarine Goldmine
products.description: A popular old cultivar. 'Goldmine' is still regarded by many as one of the highest flavoured nectarines. Nectarine 'goldmine' is one of the best garden varieties, and produces fruit of medium size with white flesh. As fruit ripens about late February - March they turn a bright orange-red over green background. The crop from this lovely tree can be abundant, sweet and plump' especially if well watered. The foliage is longish, slender, rather gracefull, and an attractive rich shade of green. The 'goldmine' is also self-fertile. Nectarines are deciduous during winter, while flowering attractive pink blooms along the upright branches closer to spring, and during this season is an excellant ornamental tree, perfect for the domestic or cottage garden. Can also be espaliered across a wall.The fruit of this above-average plant can be eaten fresh, dried, made into conserves and fruit salads to mention a few. Nectarines are a valuable food source as they are low in calories and packed with antioxidents, nutrients, minerals and vitamins. Nectarine 'goldmine' enjoys full sun, 6-8 hrs ideally, well-drained fertile soil. 'Goldmine' is also cold and frost tolerant and if you are planting during winter, if the soil is workable and no hard frost expected, it is fine to plant almost anytime. Manure enriched soil is welcome along with compost and mulch to retain moisture and deter weeds. Pruning is required to maintain the shape and health of your fruit trees. Nectarine goldmine will grow 3 - 5m tall.

products.name: Nectarine Fantasia
products.description: Nectarine 'fantasia' is one of the best garden varieties. Fantasia produces large, yellow freestone, and very edible fruit which is firm and fleshy when ripe, and very juicy. The flavour is sweet, tangy, and very rich. As fruit ripens about late August they turn a bright orange-red over yellow background. The crop from this lovely tree can be so abundant they may need thinning to acheive the best quality fruit. The foliage is longish, slender, rather gracefull, and an attractive rich shade of green. The fantasia is also self-fertile. Nectarines are deciduous during winter, while flowering attractive pink blooms along the upright branches closer to spring, and during this season is an excellant ornamental tree perfect for the domestic or cottage garden. Can also be espaliered across a wall.The fruit of this above-average plant can be eaten fresh, dried, made into conserves and fruit salads to mention a few. Nectarines are a valuable food source as they are low in calories and packed with antioxidents, nutrients, minerals and vitamins. Nectarine Fantasia enjoys full sun, 6-8 hrs ideally, well-drained fertile soil. Fantasia is also cold and frost tolerant and if you are planting during winter, if the soil is workable and no hard frost expected, it is fine to plant almost anytime. Manure enriched soil is welcome along with compost and mulch to retain moisture and deter weeds. Pruning is required to maintain shape and health of your fruit trees. Nectarine 'fantasia' will grow to 2.5m high and 2.5m wide.

products.name: Mulberry Hicks Fancy
products.description: Mulberry Hicks Fancy is a vigorous, small growing, attractive deciduous fruiting tree of green foliage. Small plump edible fruit appear in late spring and summer and will colour from red to black as it ripens. The fruit from this tree would great in jams and desserts. Prefers to be in full sun positions and moist-well drained soils. It requires alot of watering in the warmer months. Will need to be pruned yearly as fruit is produced on new growth. Mulberry Hicks Fancy will grow up to 12m high and 10m wide.

products.name: Fig Brown Turkey
products.description: Enjoy the fruits of labor and plant Fig Brown Turkey in your garden. Figs are delicious tossed through salads, serve them with cheese or eat them straight off the tree. With the majority of figs; the riper the sweeter the flavor. Fig Brown Turkey will often bear two crops in a year with the second crop extending further into autumn. This variety produces purple-brown fruit with sweet pink flesh in summer. Figs thrive in Australia's 'Mediterranean' climate and are the ideal size for most backyards. They are best grown in well-drained soils with full sun exposure. Mature trees tolerate cold and frost, however, protection is needed for new plantings until fully established. Once established, Fig Brown Turkey is hardy, and requires minimal maintenance. It is one of the toughest fig varieties. While they prefer a warm, dry climate Figs appreciate plenty of water while the fruit is developing. Apply a fertilizer annually in winter. Ensure you have a defense against birds when the tree starts fruiting. Fig Brown Turkey can grow to a height of 6 m with a width of 5 m.

products.name: Mulberry Dwarf Black
products.description: Punching above its weight in the fruit production stakes and perfectly adapted to our subtropical climes, this dwarf tree is really best described, as a large shrub. Easily kept under 3 metres and simply pruned to shape – after fruiting is best! Locate in sunny garden aspects, pick fruit when large, plump and juicy and water regularly throughout the summer months. A periodic application of a complete fertiliser, is highly recommended. A perfect plant companion for other garden edibles that is bountiful in its harvest, suitable for large containers with its lush and cool green looks throughout Spring & Summer, low care and almost guaranteed to prosper!

products.name: Apricot Moonpark
products.description: Apricot Moorpark has a clean, smooth skin shaded dark orange. Apricots are a nutritious fruit, high in Vitamin A with an incredibly sweet, juicy flavor. This particular variety is also self-pollinating. Maturing mid to late season, late January to early February. Apricot Moorpark will make an excellent addition to any garden and can be used as a feature tree. Plant in moist well-drained soil with full to partial sun exposure. Water well and keep soils moist until the tree is established. Apricot Moorpark is not drought tolerant regular watering is recommended. Use a slow-release fertilizer when planting and again after new growth appears. Prune if desired as this will encourage new healthy growth. Apricot Moorpark can grow to a height of 9 m with a width of 6 m.

products.name: Apricot
products.description: Apricot Divinity Dwarf is a captivating deciduous tree, standing at 2.5 meters tall and wide with glossy green leaves that set the stage for its stunning creamy-coloured blossoms in spring, emitting a sweet fragrance. As summer takes centre stage, these blossoms gracefully transition into small to medium-sized apricots with a captivating golden-orange hue, boasting not only an appealing appearance but also delightful flavour. This tree thrives across various landscapes, from urban gardens to pathways and containers, thriving best in well-draining soil and abundant sunlight. Its well-being and vibrancy thrive under regular maintenance, encompassing watering, fertilization, and modest pruning. Thanks to its adaptability and compact size, it stands as the perfect choice for those in search of a touch of natural refinement within more limited settings.

products.name: Apple Leprechaun™
products.description: Apple Leprechaun is a compact dwarf Granny Smith variety that produces full-size Granny Smith apples without having to be grafted onto a dwarf rootstock. This deciduous tree offers a crisp green apple and a flush of spring flowers that will bring color and bees to the garden. Apple Leprechaun is well suited to small gardens and pots due to its size, excellent for those wanting the best of both worlds; traditional full-sized fruit produced from limited space. This Apple Leprechaun will fruit from January to May and benefits from full sun exposure. Apple Leprechaun is relatively low maintenance. It does prefer regular deep watering when dry and complete fertilizing in colder winter months. It is ideal for another apple to be planted nearby; the most well-suited being Pinkabelle. Apple Leprechaun rarely requires pruning. Apple Leprechaun can grow to a height of 2 m with a width of 1 m.

products.name: Apple Granny Smith Dwarf
products.description: This Australian developed hybrid has stocked the shelves of supermarkets and homes since the discovery in 1868 by 'Granny' Anne Smith of Ryde, New South Wales; hence the name. It's well recognized for its tart flavor and distinctive lime green fruit. During spring an abundance of pale white to pink flowers bloom. Grafted onto dwarf rootstock, Apple Granny Smith Semi Dwarf is well suited to small gardens and pots due to its size but still bears full-size fruit. Excellent for those wanting the best of both worlds; traditional full-sized fruit produced from limited space. This deciduous tree will fruit from January to May and benefits from full sun exposure. Apple Granny Smith Semi Dwarf is relatively low maintenance. It does prefer regular deep watering when dry and complete fertilizing in colder winter months. It is ideal for another apple to be planted nearby; the most well-suited being Golden Delicious. Apple Granny Smith Semi Dwarf can grow to a height and width of 2.5 m.

In summer and spring, the plant produces an abundance of small, white flowers that spawn on the tip of the shrubs.
Ideal for shrubberies, screening and hedging.

products.name: Purple Japanese Maple
products.description: Acer palmatum atropurpurea is a delicate ornamental tree that adds sensational colour to any garden. With its soft lace like leaves and the distinctive foliage colour of deep purple shades in spring. Acer palmatum atropurpurea is a grafted tree so it will never outgrow it's surroundings. A perfect feature tree, especially if you have a Japanese style or formal garden. It's rounded, compact habit makes it a perfect focal point for a small garden, particularly in a container, courtyard or patio, or try it alongside a pond, where its sculptural shape will be reflected in the water. Plant in an area sheltered from strong winds and the hot afternoon sun. The Japanese maple likes moist but well draining soil on the acidic side and is full sun to shade tolerant. Mulch to retain moisture and protect roots. Fertilize in spring and autumn. Pruning should not be required. Acer palmatum atropurpurea will grow to a height of 3m and width of 2.5m.

Widely used in lawns, carparks, gardens and as street trees, Tipuana will grow nearly anywhere in Australia, can adapt to most soil types and is tolerant to drought, frost and beachside conditions. Tipuana tipu can grow to a height of up to 20 metres and a width of 12 metres.

Flowers in bright pink to scarlet erect terminal racemes, 15-20 cm long; stamens will protrude slightly from the flower. Mulching will help to retain moisture during the warmer months. Magnolia White Caviar PBR can grow to 4m high and 2m wide.

products.name: Magnolia Port Wine  (Michelia )
products.description: Port Wine Magnolia, this attractive, evergreen shrub produces deep green, glossy leaves. Throughout spring and summer, Port Wine Magnolia blooms large, fragrant flowers that are a deep purple tone. Port Wine Magnolia can be used for hedging and small screening in gardens. They are also ideal potted in large containers or pots. Michelia is a relative of the Magnolia and prefers moist, well-drained soil with a warm sunny position. Once established, Port Wine Magnolia will tolerate light frosts and moderate dry periods. Port Wine Magnolia is relatively low maintenance. Prune to shape after flowering to encourage healthy new growth. An annual application of slow-release fertilizer is encouraged, especially during spring. Water well until established and throughout extended dry periods. Port Wine Magnolia can grow to a height and width of 2 m.

This beautiful lavender is ideal for mass planting, containers, cottage gardens, rock gardens and patios. Note: Edible flowers or foliage should be picked fresh from an area that has not been exposed to any gardening chemicals and washed before consumption. Flowers are often intended only as a garnish, and should not be eaten in excess. If you are unsure whether a flower or foliage is edible, do not eat it; instead consult a Botanist or your health provider.

products.name: Grevillea Robyn Gordon
products.description: Grevillea Robyn Gordon is a small-growing, popular evergreen native shrub, which produces a profusion of red flowers that are very popular with native birds. Grevillea have exotic flowers in many colours, and Robyn Gordon is no exception. They are deep red, not unlike a tooth-brush in shape. Each flower-head is made up of small flowers which are densely crowded onto heads or spikes with their most conspicuous feature being the long styles which are first bent over like a hair pin and then straighten out. This bushy shrub has attractive lobed foliage and due to it causing skin irritation to some people it is advised to plant in an area where brushing past them can be avoided. Being a variety that flowers virtually all-year-round makes this a very decorative plant in any garden. This lovely Grevillea is very suitable for use as a boundary, in rockeries, cottage gardens, great as a hedge or screen, fine along fence lines, suitable for containers in courtyards and can be mass-planted. Robyn Gordon enjoys full sun to part-shade and as with most Grevillea, can tolerate many kinds of soil as they are very hardy and resilient. So almost any well-drained soil is preferable. As with most of these hardy natives, once established these tough plants require occasional watering during the dry hot months. Mulching to retain moisture and control weeds is an advantage. This grevillea doesn't require trimming but will tolerate a moderate to heavy pruning if required. Fertilisers containing phosphorus are best avoided. Grevillea Robyn Gordon can reach 1.5m in height and 1.5m wide. Caution: skin and eye irritant.

products.name: Grevillea Olivacea Red
products.description: Grevillea olivacea red is a Western Australian native. Commonly known as the olive leaf Grevillea due to the shape and colour of the foliage. This showy Grevillea is very popular due to its waterwise properties. Olivacea red has dense, deep-green foliage and displays a profusion of spider-like red flowers produced for an extended period from winter through to late spring. This native has an upright growing habit with densely packed foliage. This particular Grevillea is ideal as a hedge, perfect for your native garden, or as a member of your general garden. Popular with landscapers for mass plantings and ideal as a screen, it is also perfect for attracting birds to your garden. Grevilleas prefer full sun, they are hardy and drought-tolerant, and will grow in a large range of soil types, including coastal areas and gravel environments. Will tolerate periods of dryness once established, but will benefit from deep watering occasionally in dry weather. Olivacea red is low maintenance although pruning after flowering maintains the desired shape. Feeding with a low phosphorus controlled release fertilizer in early spring or late summer is beneficial. Mulch to suppress weeds and retain soil moisture. Grevillea olivacea red will grow to a height of 2.5 to 4m high and 4m wide. Caution: skin and eye irritant.

products.name: Gardenia Professor Pucci
products.description: Gardenias are stunning evergreen shrubs with lush glossy dark green foliage and beautifully perfumed white or cream-coloured flowers. Gardenia are recognized as being some of the most highly fragrant flowers in the world. Previously known as Gardenia augusta, Professor Pucci produces particularly large, soft-petaled, creamy-white double flowers which are long-lasting. These beautiful plants are suited to many situations including hedging, decorative containers in courtyards, mass plantings, and under-planting to mention a few. Plant in a partly shaded sheltered area that is well-drained and humus-enriched acidic soil. Flowering occurs during late spring and through the warmer months. If watering is maintained and some shade provided, gardenias will tolerate some high temperatures. Gardenias do like their water and will wilt when thirsty so mulching is beneficial and regular watering during the flowering season is important. Feed Gardenias regularly to promote lush foliage and heavy flowering, particularly during the growing season. Professor Pucci can be pruned/trimmed/shaped after flowering. Gardenias can also be topiarised and make a beautiful standard as a feature plant. Gardenia Professor Pucci grows to 1.2m high and 1.2m wide.

products.description: Camellia Plantation Pink produces large soft pink saucer-like, single flowers. This particular variety has a fast upright growth habit. Camellia Plantation Pink is an ideal container plant that will provide a delicate feature to any garden or landscape. This shrub can also be pruned into a hedge as well as screening. Camellias thrive in areas of full sun to semi shade and planted in a protected climate free from prolonged heavy frost. Camellia Plantation Pink benefits from soils that are acidic and well-drained. Camellia Plantation Pink does require moderate maintenance. Mulch to keep roots cool and keep dropped leaves and flowers swept or removed. Fertilising should begin with the first signs of new growth. products.name: Callistemon Bottlebrush
products.description: Bred using the two species; Callistemon Captain Cook and Callistemon Little John, Callistemon Matthew Flinders adopts the dwarf, compact growth habit of Little John along with the leaf of Captain Cook. Throughout spring and autumn, Callistemon Matthew Flinders forms masses of large, bright red bottlebrush flowers. This evergreen, bird attracting shrub will make an excellent addition to any garden or landscape. Suggested uses include screening,hedging, rockeries, low maintenance and small native gardens. Callistemon Matthew Flinders will thrive in a sunny position in well-drained soils. Callistemon are hardy, adaptable shrubs that will tolerate the poorest soils and withstand water-logging for extended periods. They are also strong against moderate coastal exposure and short periods of dryness. Callistemon Matthew Flinders is waterwise and has a low water requirement once established. Prune after flowering to promote strong new growth. Callistemon Matthew Flinders can grow to a height of 75 cm and width of 50 cm.

products.name: Bay Tree
products.description: Commonly known as the Bay Tree, Laurus nobilis is an evergreen medium tree that produces dark green aromatic foliage and small yellow flowers. This slow-growing tree is noted for its flavorsome leaves, which are usually dried and added to dishes such as soups, stews and spaghetti. Laurus nobilis is an ideal tree for topiary, hedging and screening. Plant Laurus nobilis in an area of full sun to part shade, with well-draining soils. Laurus nobilis is frost tolerant, water wise and low maintenance. Water well until established. Prune as desired as this will encourage more dense, compact growth. Laurus nobilis can grow to a height of 15 m and a width of 3 m.

Product Description: Baileys Soil Improver Plus is a mature organic compost designed to build up soil structure and improve soil fertility. Re-wetting capacity is enhanced with the addition of the soil wetter Grosorb and this product is manufactured to Australian Standards Mark 4454 and is Smart Approved and Waterwise Approved.
Application Rate:
Light Sandy Soils: distribute 150mm evenly over the surface. Dig in and water well. Approximately 150L to cover 1m squared (or 5 bags).
Medium Soils: distribute 100 to 150mm. Dig in and water well. Approximately 100L to cover 1m squared
(or 3-4 bags).
Heavy Soils: distribute 50 to 100mm worked evenly into the topsoil. Dig in and water well. Approximately 50L to cover 1m squared
(or 2 bags).
Best used for: Lawns: Prepare the area for lawn planting by removing sticks, stones and coagulated soil. Arrange your contour as desired then add Soil Improver Plus to the top soil. Garden Bed Preparation: Distribute Soil Improver Plus evenly over the area and dig into the top 150ml. Shrubs & Tree Planting: Dig the hole twice as large as the plants root ball size. Fill the hole with Soil Improver Plus as illustrated on the bag, blend the back fill in. Water well.

products.name: Baileys Energy Garden Fertiliser 10kg
products.description:
ENERGY Garden is a fully granulated, environmentally friendly, premium organic based fertiliser. It has a high analysis of trace elements, formulated to supply all the necessary nutrients poor sandy soils require. ENERGY Garden combines a range of essential nutrients, organic matter and soil amendments all in the one prill, avoiding the need for several products. High levels of calcium and potassium, in combination with blood and bone, humates and zeolite result in a slower release of fertiliser over a longer period of time. This ensures a healthier, more sustainable crop. ENERGY Garden is an ideal product for pre plant or broad acre distribution. Designed to enhance flower and fruit production, quality and quantity; rather than excessive growth, ENERGY Garden is adaptable to a wide range of soil types.
ADVANTAGES OF HUMATES
Humates encourage beer plant response in poor growing conditions. They improve plant nutrient uptake by 40%, enhancing cell division and elongation, root penetration and oxygen intake. This in turn improves fertiliser efficiency. Increased microbial activity, aids with moisture retention and improves soil structure.
Other advantages include:
Neutralises problems with pH extremes.
Reduces lockup rate of phosphate sources.
Stabilises urea.
Improves chelating and buffering of sodium
Increases beneficial fungi.
Improves nitrogen efficiency.
Stabilises most soluble fertilisers.
Supplies carbon, minimising carbon stripped from the soil.
ADVANTAGES OF ZEOLITE
Zeolite also builds up soils , increases nutrient efficiency and reduces leaching. It is negatively charged (like organic matter) attracting positively charged ions like calcium and ammonium. This making them available for plant uptake. With a very high ca on exchange capacity, Zeolite increases the ability to hold and release nutrients. A large internal surface area and porosity enables greater infiltration and retention within the soil, increases CEC and aeration. Zeolite treatment is also more permanent. It does not breakdown and performs as a soil recovery product, building up over me with the application of fertilisers. Zeolite naturally extracts phosphorus that has been locked up in the soil, enabling phosphorus uptake. This minimises leaching into our waterways, a common problem with sandy soils.

products.name: Baileys 3.1.1. Plus Lawn Fertiliser 10kg
products.description:
Baileys 3.1.1. Plus is a mini sized, fully granulated lawn fertiliser blended with Grosorb wetting agent. This balanced formula is specifically formulated for establishment of new lawns and lawn maintenance in hydrophobic (water repellent) soil conditions. The added benefit of Grosorb aids water infiltration and moisture retention, enhancing the efficiency of the lawn food, reducing watering requirements and producing a healthy drought tolerant lawn. It is ideal for warmer months and Australian conditions.
BENEFITS
Western Australian designed and manufactured product tailored to Australian conditions.
Mini size granule for easy and even distribution and quick uptake, even on finer turf surfaces.
Fully granulated to ensures all nutrients are incorporated into each granule for maximum nutrient delivery to your lawn.
A complete macro and micro nutrient fertiliser for excellent results on high profile turf surfaces such as entertaining areas.
Ideal for commercial applications on finer turf surfaces such as bowling, tennis, cricket, croquet and golf course greens.
A Waterwise Approved and Smart Approved product. The only fertiliser in Australia to have this accreditation with proven water saving properties.

A hardy plant, it is great for use in rocky areas or as an edging or a low border plant, or in a small clump planted in a pot.

products.name: Wooly Bush (Adenanthos Cunning Lighthouse)
products.description: Adenanthos cunninghamii lighthouse is an upright shrub, which produces small, unusual red jug-shaped flowers at the ends of branches during spring. An ornamental plant with beautiful soft, silvery-grey foliage. As cunninghamii is a hybrid between sercius and cuneata, Lighthouse has the best of both and is ideal for coastal planting, contrast planting and hedging. The fine furry like foliage gives a soft appearance in the garden. Can also be used for mass planting and mixed native gardens. Waterwise once established Lighthouse is very low maintenace. Best grown in full or part shade in well drained soil. Tolerates light frost and dry conditions. Prune back after flowering to maintain compact growth. Adenanthos Lighthouse will grow to a height of 1m and a width of 1m.

products.name: Acacia Honey Bun
products.description: Acacia Honey Bun is an Australian native shrub with weeping vibrant green dense foliage that will serve as a decorative piece in any garden, whilst also producing a great floral display of soft yellow flowers in spring. Acacia Honey Bun is perfect as a low informal hedge, screen, windbreak or as a potted plant. Honey Bun will thrive in sunny to partly shaded positions with moist, well drained soil. This native will also tolerate periods of dryness and light frost once established, therefore Acacia Honey Bun is low maintenance. Apply a slow release fertiliser specific for natives in spring to promote healthy new growth. When pruning this wattle, take care to maintain its weeping habit. Acacia Honey Bun will grow to a height and width of 150cm.

products.name: Acacia Burgandy Cascade
products.description: Acacia cognata Burgundy Cascade is a stunning shrub or small tree with cascading foliage. This Australian native has thin smooth green leaves with a burgundy edge that gives it an interesting range of colour throughout the year. The flowers are small, ball shaped, pale yellow and speckled throughout the foliage. This form of Acacia creates a stunning effect when planted in groups but is also equally great when used as a small specimen tree in any sized garden adding great colour and texture. Works well in large containers or as an informal hedge. Acacia cognata Burgundy Cascade prefers humus rich, moist, well drained soil in a sunny position and can tolerate most soils and most ph levels. Acacia cognata Burgundy Cascade grows to a height of 4 metres and a width of 3 metres.

products.description: With arching vibrant green foliage, Lomandra 'Katie Belles' is a graceful clumping perennial, blooming with an abundance of highly perfumed yellow flowers through spring. Flowers often stay in bloom for months at a time and can sometimes repeat flowering. Lomandra Katie 'Belles' is a full-sized evergreen Lomandra hystrix, preferring most soil types and also tolerating dry conditions. It can also withstand windy, salt laden, drought and frost positions with very low maintenance required. Plant Lomandra 'Katie Belles' in full sun to part shade locations. A key advantage of Lomandra 'Katie Belles' is its' versatility. It can be used for mass plantings, screening on roadsides, commercial and residential gardens, and also erosion control. Using chunky mulch is recommended when planting Lomandra 'Katie Belles'. Watering is necessary for the first two to three months to establish the plant. Further watering may depend on locations, in particular dryer areas such as WA.

products.name: Liriope Munros White
products.description: An evergreen perennial plant forming clumps of grass-like, dark green leaves. In late summer it produces upright spikes of rounded, bell-shaped white flowers It is widely used in landscaping - liriopes make an ideal groundcover and are suitable for planting between pavers, or for rockeries, containers, and borders. Thrives in a partly shaded position in moist, well-drained soil. tolerates light frost and periods of dryness. Grows 45cm wide x 30cm high.

products.name: Dietes Bicolor
products.description: Dietes bicolour is an evergreen perennial grown for its attractive, yellow, iris-like flowers. These flowers sit high above the lime green, sword-shaped leaves which form in large clumps. Dietes flower continuously over long periods in spring and summer, providing prolonged colour to any garden or landscape. Dietes bicolour is a versatile plant that can be used for borders, water gardens, mass plantings and is also well suited to patio pots and containers. Plant Dietes bicolour in an area of full sun to part shade, with well drained soil that is rich in organic material. Once established, Dietes bicolour is quite hardy. Dietes bicolour is waterwise and low maintenance. Fertilise occasionally and water during dry spells. Do not remove flower stems as they continue to flower for several years.

products.name: Dianella Weeping Kate
products.description: Dianella Weeping Kate is well known for it's distinctive weeping foliage and stand out blue/purple flowers and berries throughout the year. Weeping Kate makes an ideal potted specimen, garden plant or mass planted in a commercial landscape. Weekping Kate is a low growing, compact Dianella. It is hardy and tolerates temperature variations. Dianella Weeping Katre is waterwise once established but will benefit from some deep watering during extended dry periods. Dianella Weeping Kate will grow to a height of 45 centermetres by 40 centermetres wide.

products.name: Dianella Streetscape
products.description: Dianella Streetscape is a tough clumping grass, which was developed from a cross with a Cape York Dianella species and Dianella caerulea. The geographical tolerances of the parent species are inbuilt in Streetscape enabling it to cope with a wider range of temperature. Streetscape is well suited for planting in median strips, borders next to pathways, driveways, courtyards or wherever a low growing variety is required. Ideal for use in the domestic or commercial landscapes. Streetscape is low maintenance and looks great in mass plantings. Its roots grow at twice the speed of Dianella caerulea so it establishes quickly after planting. Dianella Streetscape is a waterwise plant once established. Cut back as required to encourage new healthy growth.

Great garden filler in a tropical garden or can be used as a house plant. Performs best in a shaded position with a well-drained potting mix. Ideal in pots or containers. Platinum Mist has good heat tolerance and will hold its colour in an indoor situation and will flower quite well once the plant is mature. Ensure the plant is not constantly moist but do not let the plant dry out either. Spathiphyllum Platinum Mist will grow to a height and width of 1m.

products.name: Viburnum Tinus (Laurustinus)
products.description: Viburnum Tinus is a medium to large shrub, of large, rich green, shiny leaves that are dense and leathery. In winter, this evergreen shrub produces a profusion of sweetly scented white flowers opening from pink buds, which are followed by blue-black berries. A trendy plant due to its fast-growing habit. It is an ideal hedge or screening plant, as it will block out unsightly views, creating privacy. Viburnum Tinus is also suitable as a small specimen tree for smaller gardens. Plant in an area of full sun to partial shade with moist, well-drained soils. Once established, Viburnum tinus is low maintenance, frost tolerant and will tolerate various soils and conditions. Light pruning after flowering is beneficial. Apply mulch to help with soil moisture retention. Viburnum Tinus can grow to a height of 3 m and width of 2.5 m.

products.name: Sweet Viburnum Dense Fence
products.description: Viburnum Dense Fense, commonly known as Sweet Viburnum, is a very dense, compact plant with finer reddish new growth which will grow very quickly into greener leaves. It is an ideal screening plant and will form a 2m screen in 14 months if cared for correctly. Other great uses would be as a small feature tree or a patio pot plant. It is tolerant to most soil types and prefers the full sun. Water well when establishing the plant and mulch well. Use slow release release fertiliser in spring. Prune when required to keep shape. Viburnum Dense Fense can grow up to 2.5m high and 2m wide.

products.name: Pittosporum Cream de Mint
products.description: Pittosporum Cream de Mint is a small growing, compact evergreen shrub with glossy mint-green leaves edged with a creamy white border. Clusters of orange-blossom scented, creamy white flowers appear in spring. A great plant for low hedging, borders, pots, containers and coastal areas. For best results plant in a sunny to partial shade position with moist, well drained soil. Mild drought is tolerated once established. Prune annually in winter to shape and fertilise in early spring to encourage new growth and fresh blooms. Pittosporum Cream de Mint will grow to a height of 1m and a width of 0.5m.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Allyn Magic
products.description: Acmena smithii Allyn Magic is an Australian native ideal for its use as a low hedge. Commonly known as the 'Lilly pilly', Acmena smithii Allyn Magic produces dark green foliage as well as a generous amount of new growth which is a deep bronze maroon shade, adding a spectacular contrast in any garden setting. Acmena smithii Allyn Magic will bloom small white flowers early to late summer. This plant is relatively low maintenance as it does have a high resistance to any sort of pest attack, in particular psyllids. Popular uses for Acmena smithii Allyn Magic include hedging, topiary as well as bonsai's. Its' dwarf habit makes it ideal as a low hedge for pathways. Plant Acmena smithii Allyn Magic in an area of full sun to part shade, with free-draining soil. Avoid areas exposed to heavy frost. Water regularly while establishing the plant. Use a slow-release fertilizer in spring and autumn as this plant is slow-growing and regular fertilizing will promote new growth. Prune as desired. Acmena smithii Allyn Magic will grow to a height and width of 75 cm.

products.name: Pimelea Ferruginea Magenta Mist
products.description: A compact shrub with neat, shiny, glossy green foliage. An abundance of beautiful deep pink flowers is produced above the foliage, creating a lovely floral display. An ideal addition to rockeries, garden beds or general garden situations. This shrub can tolerate most soils and climatic conditions. Fertilise in late winter with a long-term slow release fertiliser. Plant in full sun or part shade. Grows to a height of 70cm high and 70cm wide.

products.name: Pimelea Ferruginae White Solitaire
products.description: White Solitaire features beautiful, white flower clusters on a compact shrub. Now part of the Kings Park Series, White Solitaire's drought tolerance and showy spring flowering make it a great choice for larger patio pots or garden planting. The bright green, glossy foliage remains attractive year-round. Nectar-rich flowers are butterfly attracting. A very versatile variety, it is also suited to border plantings, rockeries and containers. For borders plant 50cm apart. Plant in full sun. White Solitaire is frost and drough tolerant and adaptable to a variety of soils provided they have moderate to good drainage. Trim off spent flowers and apply a small handful of general purpose slow release fertiliser after each flush of blooms to promote compact plant shape and encourage more flowers. Pimelea White Solitaire can grow to a height of 50cm and a width of 60cm.

products.name: Fijian Fire Plant
products.description: This South Pacific native shrub is known for its magnificent display of colour. With splashes of red, maroon, brown and crimson, Acalypha wilkesiana Red will provide a stunning contrast of colour in any garden or landscape. Acalypha wilkesiana Red is commonly used as a large informal hedge, screen, or specimen shrub. The large leaves make this Acalypha ideal for a tropical garden. Acaclypha wilkesiana Red prefers a sunny, warm position and will tolerate light-filtered shade. Plant Acalypha wilkesiana Red in well-drained soils, with the addition of quality organic matter to promote healthy growth. However, it is hardy and will tolerate lesser soils. A waterwise plant once established however occasional watering is recommended during long dry periods in summer. Slow-release fertiliser can be used in early spring or summer. Acalypha wilkesiana Red will grow up to a height and width of 3 metres but can be maintained at a smaller size if desired.

products.name: Red Flowering Gum
products.description: Corymbia ficifolia is an ornamental small to medium Australian Native renowned for its brilliant floral display during summer. The flower colour is variable, ranging from deep red through to pink and bright orange. Foliage is grey-green and glossy. This lovely tree will make an excellent addition to large gardens, parks and landscapes. It makes a good shade or windbreak tree. Thrives in a sunny to partly shaded position in moist, well drained soil. Tolerates coastal conditions. Protect from frost when young. Corymbia ficifolia grows 6-15m high and 5-10m wide.

Lavandula Silver Princess has a unique flower and foliage combination of eye catching candy-pink flowers which contrast beautifully with its silvery grey foliage. Its silver foliage is neat and compact, perfect for pots and containers, feature planting, pathways, rockeries and coastal gardens. Lavandula Silver Princess is relatively water wise, with low to medium water requirements. Lavandula Silver Princess can tolerate short dry periods, but appreciates a good watering after extended dry spells. Fertilise in late spring and remove dead heads for best results. Lavandula Silver Princess will grow between 20-40cm in height and 40-60cm in width. products.name: Croton Eura
products.description: Croton Eura is a spectacular Croton that originates within the flower markets of Holland. Foliage is vivid shades of green, yellow, red and orange and changes depending on the season and light conditions. In warm frost-free areas, Eura enjoys a sheltered patio or indoor position which makes a wonderful specimen in a feature pot. Also great planted in the garden in a semi-shaded, well-drained position, but will tolerate long periods of morning and afternoon sun. Keep soil moist in summer & slightly dryer in winter. Fertilize once yearly with slow-release fertilizer at the recommended dosage. Croton Eura will grow to a height of 1-1.5m and a width of 1m.

products.name: Croton Mammy
products.description:

In warm frost-free areas 'Super Mammy' enjoys a sheltered well-lit position in patios which makes a wonderful specimen in a feature pot. Also, great planted in the garden in a semi-shaded, well-drained position. Keep soil moist in summer & slightly dryer in winter. Fertilize once yearly with slow-release fertilizer at the recommended dosage. Croton 'Super Mammy', in milder climates with high humidity, can be grown in full sun which will encourage richer coloring in the foliage. Fertilize twice yearly with slow-release fertilizer at the recommended dosage. Croton 'Super Mammy' will grow to a height of 1-1.5m and a width of 1m. This can vary, depending on location.

products.description: Phormium Wildwood is a popular, large growing flax with graceful dark purple foliage that slightly arches towards the tips. This hardy perennial is popularly grown for its contrasting foliage colour, adding a modern-contemporary form to any garden or landscape. Use the bright foliage to add colour and contrast as an outstanding feature plant, border in both the garden or pots and containers. This species thrives best in a sunny to partly shaded position, with well drained soil. Phormium Wildwood is hardy, tolerating most condition and soil types, and is relatively low maintenance once established. Apply mulch in spring to reduce weed growth and to keep the roots moist. Protect from moderate frosts. Ensure the crown of the plant is not planted below the soil level. Phormium Wildwood can grow to a height and width of 1.5 metres.

products.name: Dianella Rainbow Twist
products.description: Dianella Rainbow Twist is a unique plant with of course the rainbow colours and effect. The twisting foliage change colours from season to season. It autumn and winter the colours combination is deep reds to purple, while in spring/summer colours are lighter. Ideal for mass planting or feature planting in any domestic or commercail landscape. Rainbow Twist prefers good draining soils. It is waterwise and very drought and frost tolerant once established. Remove older foliage. Fertilise with slow realease fertiliser when established and then only when required. Do not over water.

products.name: Dianella Caerulea Little Jess
products.description: Dianella caerulea Little Jess is a hardy native grass with glossy dark emerald foliage. Little Jess is a dwarf with a clumping growth habit. Its' short, compact canes produce masses of bold violet flowers which cascade and contrast against its' vibrant green foliage. In summer it will produce attractive clusters of purple berries. Dianella Little Jess can be used in a variety of areas including most commercial and residential plantings, mass plantings, roadsides, and excellent for erosion control. It prefers full sun and moderate to heavy shaded positions. Little Jess is waterwise and has the ability to tolerate drought and humidity making it suitable for a variety of soils. Water until established, further watering will depend on climate. Plant in a well mulched garden, and prune as desired. Slow release fertiliser can be used every spring if necessary.

products.name: Dianella King Alfred
products.description: Dianella King Alfred has unique, blue green foliage that is dense and compact. This plant is a tidy plant which will flower September to March with purple and yellow flowers. The flowers will extend to 1m high. Plant in full sun to part shade. It tolerates humidity and cold. It is suitable for most soils, but try to avoid very poor soils.

products.name: Dianella Clarity Blue PBR
products.description: Dianella Clarity Blue is a clumping Ozbreed plant with clean, blue foliage. It is tougher and better performing than the variety Utopia. It will produce amazing blue flower stems in the summer months. Clarity Blue is a low maintenance plant, and can be used as an accent plant or in a group of planting for contrast. It would go well any garden. Prefers full sun to part shade areas and tolerates drought and frost. Well drained soils are preferred as well. To establish, water well for 8 to 13 weeks and then after make sure not to over water. Plant in well mulched areas and use slow release fertiliser.

The reddish-colored calyces are an added feature after flowering. This ornamental shrub is ideal for any domestic garden or a landscape project, whether it be a low informal hedge or a border shrub, mass planted or equally stunning on its own. Plant Abelia Grandflora in full sun to partial shade with well-drained fertile soils with ample summer moisture. Prune to remove spent calyces and old basal shoots to maintain bushiness. products.name: Philodendron Xanadu
products.description: Philodendron Xanadu adds a tropical feel to your indoor or outdoor garden. This evergreen, compact plant produces glossy, lime green leaves that are dramatically lobed, creating a dense, tidy growth habit. An ideal addition to any shaded garden, excellent along borders, or mass planted as an understory plant. Plant in an area of full sun to semi shade. It can be grown in the garden in tropical and subtropical areas. In colder parts, it is best grown as an indoor or patio plant, under high light conditions. Philodendron Xanadu is low maintenance and pest free. It does not produce aerial roots and has a wide climatic tolerance. Remove old and damaged leaves and protect from frost. Philodendron Xanadu can grow to a height of 90 centimetres and width of 70 centimetres.

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text:
Plant this species in an area of full sun to part shade, with well-drained soil. If planting indoors, ensure that the area is well lit. This plant grows best in tropical and subtropical gardens as well as coastal locations. Even so, the plant can cope with reasonably cold winters, but not frost. Liquid fertilise the plant regularly and water only when dry.

products.description: Commonly known as the West Australian Weeping Peppermint, Agonis flexuosa can be found in many backyards, gardens, and landscapes across the state. This medium-sized tree produces pendulous green leaves with red new growth providing a stunning contrast. It has a weeping habit and produces masses of small white flowers in spring. Agonis flexuosa is an ideal specimen tree and once mature a very useful shade tree. Agonis flexuosa is also a tough street tree or looks stunning mass planted in parklands or along pathways. As the tree ages, the trunk takes on a character of its own and has some interesting creases and bumps. This particular variety prefers full sun and will thrive on the coast in sandy well-drained soils, which makes it suitable for many areas in the southwest. Agonis flexuosa is hardy and withstands drought and dry conditions. Agonis flexuosa is relatively low maintenance. For best results, opt for a slow-release native fertilizer and feed during early spring. Agonis flexuosa will most of the time only grow to about 10 m high, but can sometimes reach 14m and width of 10 m. Buy West Australian Weeping
