products.name: Myoporum (PBR) Yareena
products.description: Myoporium parvifolium 'Yareena' is a quick-growing ground-cover suited to a wide range of conditions. It is quite delicate to look at, with a fresh, stiff green foliage of narrow, blunt, thick, semi-succulent leaves. The flower clusters are fragrantly honey-scented and made up of white tubular flowers from late spring to early summer. These are followed by globular berries. This attractive, low-maintenance plant is ideal for filling those gaps, under-planting, cascading down embankments or trailing over retaining walls and raised garden beds, or any situation requiring a rather lush-looking groundcover. Myoporums prefer full-sun to part-shade, and will grow in almost any soil, including inland clays and heavy soils, as long as they are well drained. Also tolerant of coastal regions and waterwise when established, surviving high temperatures of 30 to 40 degrees, and is also high-frost/cold tolerant to -7 degrees. Once this native is established, low water is required, as it is drought-tolerant. As with most plants, a little well-composted mulch is beneficial for retaining moisture and deterring weeds. Being a low-maintenance plant, little pruning is required, only as needed. A slow-release low-phosphorus fertiliser in spring. Myoporum parvifolium 'Yareena will grow to 10cm tall and 1m plus wide.

products.description:
The Bangalow Palm (Archontophoenix cunninghamiana) is a tall palm. This plant has dark green foliage and a smooth grey trunk. It’s leaves resemble feathers and gives the foliage a soft look. In the spring to summer seasons, this palm blooms fragrant mauve flowers, followed by bright red, fleshy fruits that hang from multiple stems below the foliage.
Bangalow Palm can be used as a feature tree and is ideal for those wanting to add a tropical addition to their everyday garden.

care.title: Care Instructions

products.name: Alexander Palm
products.description: Archontophoenix alexandrae is a tall and slender palm, more commonly known as the Alexander Palm. This Australian native originates from central and northern Queensland's coastal rainforests, but they are also more commonly grown in gardens across the country. Archontophoenix alexandrae forms feather-like dark green foliage that is ash white underneath, giving a delicate appearance. Archontophoenix alexandrae can be used as a feature, or mass planted along streets. This palm is also ideal for those wanting to add a tropical addition to their everyday garden. Plant Archontophoenix alexandrae in a warm area with exposure to full sun and well draining soils. Water Archontophoenix alexandrae well until established. If using this palm indoors, ensure that the area is well lit. This palm does require more watering in comparison to other varieties. Archontophoenix alexandrae can grow to a height of 15 metres with a width of 3 metres.

products.name: Jacaranda
products.description: This South-American native has been widely planted globally due to its elegant long-lasting flowers. These lilac-blue, tubular flowers bloom during spring to summer and provide stunning colour during these months. Jacaranda mimosifolia forms semi-evergreen attractive fern-like foliage. Jacaranda mimosifolia is ideal as a feature tree in avenue or street plantings; however its moderate size means it is also well suited to suburban gardens as stunning specimen or feature tree. Jacaranda mimosifolia grows well in a sunny to partly shaded position, with moist, well draining soil. Jacaranda mimosifolia is waterwise and will benefit from light watering during summer months. Jacaranda mimosifolia can grow to a height of 15 metres and a width of 10 metres.

products.name: Grevillea Rsl Spirit of Anzac (PBR)
products.description: This new variety of Grevillea bred by Kings Park and Botanic Gardens for the RSL, to commemorate the Anzac Centenary, marking 100 years since Australian and New Zealand forces first stormed the shores of Gallipoli and the many other conflicts since then. The Grevillea has thrived and survived, as has the ANZAC spirit in times of hardship. The RSL Spirit of ANZAC Grevillea was selected for its lush bird attracting red flowers that appear from autumn to summer and its trans-Australian heritage and the tough geographical conditions in which it grows and thrives. This variety will thrive in well drained soils and is very drought tolerant. Prune in spring to keep compact and promote mass flowering, if left to grow to its full potential it will reach 2m height x 1.5m wide. Once established it will grow and flower well with twice weekly irrigation over summer and rainfall during the winter months.

products.name: Grevillea Lemon Daze
products.description: Grevillea Lemon Daze is a lovely, long, flowering small shrub with pendulous bright yellow and pink flowers from autumn through winter and onto spring. Attracting birds and nectar-loving insects, Lemon Daze brings life and tranquillity to your garden. It is best in a sunny spot in well-drained soil. Suitable for all native and rock gardens, mass planted, or as a feature in a larger decorative container in your outdoor entertainment areas. An excellent easy care plant, a light prune every so often will ensure good dense growth. Drought and frost-tolerant once established. Grevillea Lemon Daze will grow to a height of 0.8-1.5m and a width of 0.8-1.5m.

products.name: Grevillea Lady PBR
products.description: Grevillea Lady O is a medium sized spreading shrub bearing a host of bright red flowers. Under mild conditions plants can flower all year round. Adaptable to a wide range of conditions. Frost hardy. Grows to a height of 1.5m high and 2m wide.

products.name: Michelia (Lady of the Night Magnolia)
products.description: Michelia 'Lady of the Night' is an attractive, evergreen shrub that produces deep green, glossy leaves. 'Lady of the Night' blooms large, cream, fragrant flowers that are tinted with magenta throughout spring and summer. This plant can be used for hedging and small screening in gardens. They are also ideal potted in large containers or pots. Michelia 'Lady of the Night' is a relative of the Magnolia. It prefers moist, well-drained soil with a warm sunny position. Once established, it will tolerate light frosts and moderate dry periods and is relatively low maintenance. Prune to shape after flowering to encourage healthy new growth. An annual application of slow-release fertilizer is encouraged, especially during spring. Water well until established and throughout extended dry periods. Michelia 'Lady of the Night' can grow to a height and width of 4 m.

products.name: Senetti Baby Magenta Bicolour PBR
products.description: Senetti® Baby Magenta Bicolour PBR an easy care, prolific flowering perennial with green foliage and magenta-pink flowers that bloom in autumn, winter and spring. Growing very quickly to an average height of 30cm and 40 wide, Senetti® are ideal for planting in pots for that flush of colour or mass borders. Soil and sun conditions can vary, they prefer protection from the wind and adore the morning sun, best suited to free draining soil. Senetti® Magenta Bicolour PBR grows to 30cm high and 40cm wide.

products.name: Grevillea Wooly Bear Hero
products.description: Grevillea Woolly Bear Hero is a very compact, soft, mounding groundcover shrub bearing massed waxy pink and white flowers. The flowering season of this delightful shrub is virtually all-year-round making it a very desireable plant in many different situations. Being extremely drought hardy, this is very useful mass planted as a ground cover, as path edges and great in rockeries. Woolly Bear Hero is also suitable on embankments. This plant prefers full sun or part shade for best results, is medium frost-tolerant and grows well in a range of climates including cool-temperate to sub-tropical semi arid and 1st coastal line. Gravelly soils neutral to acid pH or well drained clay loam and sandy soils are preferred. Minimal tip pruning to maintain shape is all that is required along with a low P fertiliser as needed. Once established Woolly Bear Hero is waterwise needs minimal watering. Grevillea lanigera Woolly Bear Hero will grow 10 - 30cm high and 1-1.5m wide.

products.name: Grevillea Hills Jubilee
products.description: Grevillea Hills Jubilee is a hardy evergreen compact shrub, with fine green foliage and abundant spider-like flowers in beautiful pink and white. This is a lovely Grevillea to add to your garden as it attracts nectar feeding birds. Perfect for your native garden or rockery but also suited to pots and as a cut flower arrangement. Planted in full sun for maximum flowering, it will also tolerate light shade. As with most Grevillea, Hills Jubilee will tolerate dry periods once established. Water regularly during the first 8-12 weeks until the plant is established. Pruning after flowering will promote further flowering, dense habit and control growth. A hard prune each 3-4 years will result in a fresh flush of flowers and foliage. Feed with a slow release native fertiliser when buds form - grevillea can be phosphorus-sensitive. Prefers free draining soil. Caution: skin and eye irritant.

products.name: Canna Tropicana Black
products.description: Create a tropical oasis in your garden with Canna 'Tropicanna Black'. Canna Tropicanna Black is widely recognised for its deep purple to black shaded foliage. During summer and autumn Canna Tropicanna Black produces large rich orange-red flowers. Canna Tropicanna Black is ideal for use in pots, mass planted and also makes an eye-catching border. When planting, situate Canna Tropicanna Black in an area of full sun to partial shade with damp, moist soils. It will tolerate poorly drained areas. Canna Tropicanna Black will grow almost anywhere and has a high resistance to virus. Exposure to cold or insufficient water will cause Canna Tropicanna Black to lose colour. Protect from frosts and wind. Use snail bait when plants are young to combat infestation. After flowering, remove old canes to promote lush growth and new flowers. Canna Tropicanna Black can grow to a height and width of 1 metre.

products.name: Tiger Grass
products.description: Tiger grass is an attractive feature plant that looks like bamboo but is a fast-growing, non-invasive perennial grass. Tight clumps of slim stems and lush leaves reach 2.5m high and are ideal for blocking fences while adding a tropical feel to the garden. It is also excellent as a specimen plant in garden beds or pots. Tiger grass prefers full to partly-shaded areas of moist, rich soil and protected from frosts. Cut back old stems as required. Grows to 2.5m high by 1m wide

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text: Tiger grass prefers full to part-shaded area of moist rich soil and prefers tropical or subtropical climates. This species is NOT frost tolerant. water regularly until established. Cut back old stems as required.

The colour of new growth on leaves is pink, which then turns dark green, and are glossy with wavy edges and brown undersides. It is ideal for screening or hedging as it can be pruned to shape, and can also be placed in large pots or containers.

care.title: Care Instructions

products.name: Dianella Hybrid Variegated
products.description: Dianella hybrid variegated is an evergreen perennial and is a great addition to any garden. The foliage has a unique appearance with creamy white margins bordering wide green leaves. Stalks of shiny blue berries appear above the foliage in autumn and winter and create a colourful accent in the garden. Dianella hybrid variegated has proved itself in the landscape over the many years it has been in production. It is suited to both domestic and commercial plantings and also performs well in the north west of Western Australia. Dianella hybrid variegated is waterwise once established and will grow in full sun to part shade. autumn and winter is a good time to cut back to reinvigorate them for spring and will produce healthy new growth. A good balanced slow realease fertiliser in spring every 1-2years can help performance. This plant is tough and heat resistant in a well drained soil area. Can grow up to 1 metre high and wide if in an irrigated landscape, otherwise in most landscapes it might stay around 50cm high.

Can be placed as a good ground cover underneath tree canopies as well as being suitable and recommended as an indoor decorative feature plant.

products.name: Pink Jasmine
products.description:
Jasminum Polyanthum or the Pink Jasmine is an evergreen perennial climber plant native to China and Burma. It is a lively climber which that produces prolific clusters of reddish pink flower buds, which turn into white, star-shaped flowers during the late winter to mid-spring seasosns. It's leave habit mainly consists of 5 to 9 compund leaflets that are dark green in colour and grow away from the wall they are climbing.
The Pink Jasmine is suitable in all types of gardens and is used primarily as coverage of fences, pergolas, arches and walls.

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text: Though native to China and Burma, This plant had adapted itself to our Australian climate. It is an easy grower to conditions here in WA. Place in an environment of full sun to part shade within moist, well-drained soils. Prune annually to promote bushy growth, as well as to keep the plant away from unwanted areas.

products.name: Pittosporum Screenmaster (PBR)
products.description: Pittosporum Screenmaster is an upright variety creating perfect height, structure and form. It is faster growing, bushier and sturdier than other Pittosporums of its type. Widely used as a hedge or screening plant, providing coverage for those seeking privacy or wanting to cover up an undesirable area of the garden. Plant in an area of full sun to part shade, with well drained soil. Prune regularly to maintain a desired height, which can be as low as 50 centimetres. When planting as a hedge, space 75 centimetres apart. Mulch during summer to conserve moisture. A low maintenance plant Pittosporum tenuifolium Screenmaster can grow to a height of 3-4 metres and a width of 2 metres.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Winterlight
products.description: L ily Pillies are evergreen rainforest plants with glossy, deep green leaves and are one of the most popular hedging plants. Many varieties have flushes of colourful new growth, ranging from bright pinks, to red and browns. This particular variety, Winter Lights, is grown for its narrow growth habit, and brilliant red new growth. During summer, Winter Lights will bloom fluffy white flowers, followed by small, edible berries. Winter Lights is ideal for hedging, screening and topiary and can be grown in containers. Plant in a warm area, protected from frost and well-drained soil. Being native, this variety is well accustomed to Australia's diverse climate and soil conditions and once established will tolerate coastal and drought conditions. Water well until established and during extended hot periods. Prune to shape to encourage dense growth habits. Syzygium Winter Lights can grow to a height of 5 m and a width of 1.5 m.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Resilience
products.description: Resilience, is known for its brilliant red new growth. During summer, Resilience will bloom fluffy white flowers, followed by small, edible berries. Its name derives from the fact that Resilience is highly resistant to many pests, diseases and psyllids which can affect Lilly Pillies. Resilience is ideal for hedging, screening and topiary and can be grown in containers. Plant in a warm area, protected from frost and well-drained soil. Being native, this variety is well accustomed to Australia's diverse climate and soil conditions and once established will tolerate coastal and drought conditions. Water well until established and during extended hot periods. Prune to shape to encourage dense growth habits. Syzygium Resilience can grow to a height of 4 m and a width of 1.5 m.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Orange Twist
products.description: Orange Twist is known for its attractive, glossy orange new growth, that transforms to green as it matures and upright growing habit. During Spring, masses of fluffy white flowers are borne, followed by edible purple berries. Orange Twist is ideal for hedging, screening and topiary and can be grown in containers. Plant in a warm area, protected from frost and well-drained soil. Being native, this variety is well accustomed to Australia's diverse climate and soil conditions and once established will tolerate coastal and drought conditions. Water well until established and during extended hot periods. Prune to shape to encourage dense growth habits. Orange Twist can grow to a height of 3 m and a width of 1 m.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Cherry Surprise
products.description:
Lillly Pilly Cherry Surprise is a naturally compact, extremely hardy plant with striking bright red new growth that contrasts beautifully with the older green foliage. Small cream flowers appear in spring and summer. Perfect for hedging, screening and topiary. It can withstand light frost and is drought tolerant and psyllid resistant. Mulch well after planting and water well in dry weather. Prune lightly after flowering to maintain a dense hedge. Fertilize with a slow-release fertilizer in late winter and early autumn.
Height 3m high x 1.5m wide - to hedge plant 75 cm apart.

products.name: Lilly Pilly Bush Christmas

Bush Christmas is ideal for hedging, screening and topiary and can also be grown in containers. Plant in a warm area, protected from frost and well-drained soil. products.name: Moses in the Cradle
products.description: A perfect addition to any garden, Moses in the Cradle is an evergreen, semi-succulent, clump-forming perennial. Grown for its attractive dark leaves with purple undersides. It makes an ideal groundcover, rockery plant or used for edging as well as an excellent landscaping plant or just in a container or trough on its own. Requires minimal attention. products.name: Mondo Grass Black
products.description: Ophiopogon Nigrescens forms tufts of slender, grass-like foliage that can spread rapidly once established. This evergreen perennial variety differs as it produces striking purplish-black leaves that will prove an excellent contrast against green leaved plants. Mondo grass is a popular border choice for dividing garden and pathways, it will also grow as a dense ground cover in areas of full sun to part shade. Flourishing in soils that are sandy, loam as well as clay based; given they are well drained and will tolerate frost and wind. Water well until established and keep soil moist during dry weather. Use slow release fertiliser annually. If planting in containers, use a premium potting mix. Ophiopogon planiscapus Nigrescens can grow to a height and width of 25 centimetres.

products.name: Dianella Tasmanica Wyeena
products.description: Dianella Wyeena is a great Australian plant for frost-affected areas compared to other Dianellas. The striking foliage makes a great eye-catcher in any garden and provides a strong contrast. Ideal for mass planting or a foliage feature in any ceramic pot. Grow Wyeena in full sun to any range of shade, suits any soil type, and is an asset to any garden. Remove any leaves that get scrappy in spring. Fertilize with a slow-release compound occasionally if required. Dianella Wyeena can grow to a height of 90 centimeters and a width of 70 centimeters.

products.name: Dianella Cassa Blue
products.description: Dianella Cassa Blue is a compact, upright, clumping rather than spreading variety of Dianella, suited to any commercial or home garden. Once established, Cassa Blue is one of the toughest Dianella grasses. The rich blue foliage is an eye catching contrasting feature in any garden. Cassa Blue will flower more than most other Dianella for about two months in Spring followed by berries. Ideal for coastal plantings, mass planting and exposed positions. Dianella Cassa Blue is waterwsie and frost tolerant once established, and is suitable to most soil types and areas. Fertilise with slow release fertiliser once a year and trim foliage to give a neat, vibrant look to the plant. Grows to 50cm in well drained soil types.

products.name: Dianella Tasred
products.description:
Dianella Tasred is a compact Australian native with bright green and red strap-like leaves, a real showpiece for any garden. In cooler weather, the red tones radiate from the plant's crown into the leaf margins; while Spring brings a show of rich blue flowers. Its dense and tidy appearance has the ability to cope with full sun to full shade. Dianella Tasred has beautiful wide leaves, making it one of the most popular choices of Dianella. Masses of purple berries appear in Spring and Summer. Can be described as an ornamental flax, requiring fertilising once in Spring, well suited in any soil and great for any garden or border. Dianella Tasred is an ideal waterwise plant for any commercial or domestic planting and looks great when mass planted.
Flowering Season Spring

products.name: Dianella Breeze
products.description:
Dianella Breeze is a tidier form of Dianella caerulea, without the unattractive messy canes that descend over the plant. It is equipped with cascading dark green foliage and the occasional spray of delicate blue flowers in spring followed by an array of rich purple berries. Dianella caerulea Breeze tolerates a variety of situations including drought, windy and salt laden positions and heavy frost; growing well in full sun and moderate to heavy shade positions. Dianella Breeze is very fast growing. With the many characteristics as noted above, Dianella Breeze is perfect for erosion control, mass plantings and great as an under storey plant for both dense and light tree plantings. Its' underground root structure will fill gaps and will outperform against weeds, making it key to cover the border of paths and roads. Ideal for both commercial and domestic landscapes Breeze looks great mass planted. Dianella Breeze is waterwise. Regular watering is required for the first 2-3 months to establish the plant, however often further watering is not necessary unless set in sandy conditions. Dianella Breeze can tolerate excessive dry and wet conditions.
Flowering Season Spring

products.description: Alocasia macrorrhiza is a perennial with large heart shaped leaves with pale yellow scented flowers followed by red berries. It thrives in rainforests and moist coastal environments. Prefers shady moist well-drained soils. Grows well in amongst ferns and other shade loving plants. Great container plant. Known to be poisonous if eaten. Water well during the warmer months and keep drier in winter. Alocasia Macrorrhiza will grow to a height of 1.5-2m and a width of 1.5-2m.

The Cordyline Caruba Black is a beautiful evergreen tropical plant which is really unique for its exceptionally dark green, almost black foliage. Prune sparingly to maintain shape and dense growth.

products.name: Mandevilla Classic Dark Red
products.description:
This variant of the Mandevilla is a fast-growing seeking climber. During warmer months and in most tropical seasons, the plant produces deep red flowers throughout the entire year from the part-shrub, part-climber foliage. In an environment of full sun, it remains a small and unassuming shrub. However, when placed in an area of shade, the plant begins to sprout branches and become a climber.
As a climber, this plant is ideal for decorating trellises and fences, carports and verandahs. As a shrub, this plant is well suited as a potted feature plant for patios and alfresco areas.
For more details about this item, please call 0420 493 944.

care.title: Care Instructions
care.text:

Use a control release fertiliser to maintain good plant health and growth
Prune when the plant reaches unwanted areas.

products.name: Fountain Bamboo
products.description: Fargesia Fortune are commonly known as Fountain Bamboo. Fortune has a vertical growth pattern, with the new culms emerging purple with a white powdery coating. This is an excellent screening plant and makes the ideal hedge. Fargesia is a non-invasive bamboo variety highly suited to the home garden. It can withstand cold winters and windy conditions and grow well in full sun or partial shade. Fargesia bamboo thrives in rich organic soils and is relatively drought-tolerant once established. For optimal growth, water twice a week and mulch through the summer. Fargesia Fortune can grow to a height of 4m and a width of 2m.
